words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.ex: The book has many illustrations to help children understand.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有很多插图来帮助孩子理解。
words.en: Illustrations are pictures or diagrams that are used to explain or decorate a book, magazine, or other text.

words.ex: He loves reading comics on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看漫画。
words.en: Comics are magazines or books that contain stories told in pictures with speech bubbles or captions.

words.tr: phrase. 针对…的；以…为目标的
words.ex: The ad is targeted at children.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告针对儿童。
words.en: If something is targeted at a particular group of people, it is intended for that group.

words.tr: v. 遭遇海难； adj. 遭遇海难的；v. 遭遇海难，船只失事（shipwreck 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The sailors were shipwrecked on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 水手们遭遇海难，被困在一个小岛上。
words.en: If someone is shipwrecked, their ship has been destroyed in an accident at sea and they have managed to reach land.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.tr: v. 移动；“move”的现在分词；搬家； adj. 运动的；感人的；动人的；可移动的；
words.ex: The boy is moving his toy car.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩正在移动他的玩具车。
words.en: If something is moving, it makes you feel strongly touched or emotional.

words.ex: Marine archaeology helps us understand ancient maritime cultures.
words.ex_cn: 海洋考古学帮助我们理解古代海洋文化。
words.en: Marine archaeology is the study of human interaction with the sea, lakes, and rivers through the recovery and analysis of material culture such as vessels, shore installations, and other physical remains.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.ex: The old attic was a treasure trove of vintage toys.
words.ex_cn: 那个旧阁楼是古董玩具的宝库。
words.en: A treasure trove is a collection of valuable or interesting things, especially one that has been hidden or discovered by chance.

words.ex: The museum displays ancient artefacts from Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了来自埃及的古代人工制品。
words.en: An artefact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.tr: adj. 自治的；有自治权的；自主的；
words.ex: The region has autonomous control over its education system.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区对其教育系统拥有自治权。
words.en: An autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself.

words.tr:
v. 移动；操控；
n. （熟练地）移动；
words.ex: He manoeuvred the car into a small parking space.
words.ex_cn: 他把车开进了一个小停车位。
words.en: A manoeuvre is a movement or series of movements requiring skill and care, especially in military tactics or in driving a vehicle. It can also refer to a clever or cunning plan or action designed to turn a situation to one's own advantage.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The map shows the coordinates of the treasure.
words.ex_cn: 地图显示了宝藏的坐标。
words.en: Coordinates refer to a set of numbers that determine the position of a point, line, or shape in space. As a verb, it means to bring different elements into a relationship that will ensure efficiency or harmony.

words.ex: The company will deploy new software next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周部署新软件。
words.en: To deploy troops or military resources means to organize or position them so that they are ready to be used.

words.ex: The trash receptacle is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: A receptacle is an object or space used to contain something.

words.ex: The ancient statue was made of terracotta.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代雕像由赤陶制成。
words.en: Terracotta is a type of fired clay, typically of a brownish-red color and unglazed, used as an ornamental building material and in modeling.

words.ex: He takes a cookery class every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周六上烹饪课。
words.en: A cookery class is a course where people are taught how to prepare and cook food.

words.tr: phrase. 季节性产品；指仅在特定季节生产或销售的商品
words.ex: The store sells seasonal products like snow boots in winter.
words.ex_cn: 商店在冬天出售雪地靴等应季产品。
words.en: Products that are available or in demand only during certain seasons of the year.

words.tr: phrase. 私人课程；一对一授课；私教课
words.ex: He takes a private lesson every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六上一节私教课。
words.en: A private lesson is a one-on-one teaching session between a teacher and a student, focusing on the student's individual needs and pace.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.tr: 专门研究，专攻；专门从事【动词短语】
words.ex: He specialises in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他专攻计算机科学。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.tr: phrase. 素食菜肴；指不含肉类或鱼类的餐点
words.ex: She cooks vegetarian dishes every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都做素食菜肴。
words.en: Dishes that are made without any meat or fish, often emphasizing vegetables, grains, and sometimes dairy products or eggs.

words.tr: n. 材料；组成部分；“ingredient”的复数；
words.ex: The recipe lists all the ingredients you need.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱列出了你需要的所有材料。
words.en: The ingredients of something are the things that are used to make it, especially in cooking.

words.tr: n. 磨快；磨尖 v. （使）提高( sharpen的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The sharpening of the knife took only a few minutes.
words.ex_cn: 把刀磨快只花了几分钟。
words.en: The act of making something sharp or sharper, or the process of becoming sharp or sharper.

words.tr: phrase. 切割技巧；切菜方法
words.ex: Mastering chopping techniques is essential for preparing various dishes.
words.ex_cn: 掌握切剁技巧对于准备各种菜肴至关重要。
words.en: Chopping techniques refer to the methods and skills used in cutting food items into smaller pieces, often as a preparation step in cooking.

words.tr: phrase. 已订满的；已预约完的
words.ex: The hotel is booked up for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店周末已经订满了。
words.en: Fully occupied or reserved; having no available space or time.

words.tr: phrase. 种子萌发；种子发芽
words.ex: The seed germination happened after three days of rain.
words.ex_cn: 种子在三天降雨后发芽了。
words.en: The process by which a plant grows from a seed.

words.tr: phrase. 选修模块；可选课程单元
words.ex: The algebra module is optional for first-year students.
words.ex_cn: 对于一年级学生来说，代数模块是可选的。
words.en: A course or component of a program that students can choose to take or not take, often to tailor their studies to specific interests or career goals.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.tr: phrase. 化学分析；通过化学方法对物质成分进行鉴定和测定的过程
words.ex: The lab did a chemical analysis of the water.
words.ex_cn: 实验室对水进行了化学分析。
words.en: The process of determining the chemical composition of a substance.

words.ex: The dimensions of the box are 10 cm by 5 cm by 3 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米乘3厘米。
words.en: Dimensions refer to the measurements of something, such as its length, width, and height, or the aspects and features of a situation or problem.

words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.ex: He put the flower in a plant pot.
words.ex_cn: 他把花放在花盆里。
words.en: A container, typically made of plastic or clay, in which plants are grown.

words.tr: adj. 基因改造的；转基因的
words.ex: Genetically-modified foods have been a subject of much debate.
words.ex_cn: 转基因食品一直是备受争议的话题。
words.en: Altered by genetic engineering; modified at the DNA level.

words.tr: phrase. 城市环境；都市生态环境
words.ex: Children play in urban environments with many buildings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在有很多建筑物的城市环境中玩耍。
words.en: Areas characterized by high population density and human-made structures.

words.ex: In evolutionary terms, humans changed slowly over millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 从进化角度来看，人类在数百万年里缓慢变化。
words.en: Referring to concepts or language used in the study of biological change over time.

words.ex: The war caused great upheavals in the country.
words.ex_cn: 战争给这个国家带来了巨大的动荡。
words.en: Upheavals are sudden, violent changes or disturbances that cause a lot of trouble, confusion, and worry.

words.ex: Children are often adaptable to new environments.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通常能适应新环境。
words.en: If someone or something is adaptable, they are able to change their ideas or behaviour in order to deal with new situations.

words.tr:
n. 栖枝；鲈鱼；
v. 栖息；处于（高处）；
words.ex: The bird sat on a perch near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在树旁的一根栖枝上。
words.en: A perch is a branch or rod where a bird rests or a high position where someone or something is located. As a verb, it means to rest or be located in a high position.

words.ex: Many immigrants work hard to build a new life.
words.ex_cn: 许多移民努力工作以建立新的生活。
words.en: Immigrants are people who come to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: The scientist examined the specimens under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在显微镜下检查了这些标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single example of something, such as a plant, animal, or mineral, that is used as a typical example of its kind.

words.ex: Children develop cognitive skills as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive means relating to the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.

words.ex: He gave a bold speech in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前发表了大胆的演讲。
words.en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

words.ex: The endocrine systems control hormones in the body.
words.ex_cn: 内分泌系统控制身体中的激素。
words.en: The endocrine systems are a network of glands that produce and release hormones that help control many important body functions.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 激素控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: Hormones are chemicals produced by the body that regulate the activity of cells or organs. They play a key role in many body processes, including growth, metabolism, and reproduction.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.ex: His silence had serious implications.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默有严重的暗示。
words.en: The implications of something are the things that are likely to happen as a result of it.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: He majors in textile design at art school.
words.ex_cn: 他在艺术学校主修纺织品设计。

words.tr: phrase. 天然染料；指从植物、动物或矿物中提取的用于染色的天然物质
words.ex: She uses natural dyes to color her clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用天然染料给衣服上色。
words.en: Dyes derived from natural sources such as plants, minerals, or insects, used for coloring fabrics and materials.

words.ex: She buys soft fabrics for her dresses.
words.ex_cn: 她为自己的连衣裙购买柔软的布料。
words.en: Fabrics are materials made by weaving or knitting fibers together, used for making clothes, curtains, etc., or the structure or foundation of something.

words.ex: The equation has two variables, x and y.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程有两个变量，x 和 y。
words.en: In mathematics and programming, a variable is a symbol used to represent an unknown or changeable value.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.tr: phrase. 过敏反应；指身体对某些物质（如花粉、食物、药物等）产生的异常免疫反应
words.ex: Some people have allergic reactions to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 有些人对花生会产生过敏反应。
words.en: Unwanted immune system responses to substances like pollen or certain foods.

words.tr: phrase. 不再被使用；废弃不用
words.ex: This old machine fell out of use after the new one arrived.
words.ex_cn: 新机器到来后，这台旧机器就不再使用了。
words.en: If something falls out of use, it is no longer used.

words.tr: v. <正>吃，吞下；<正>吃，吞下( ingest的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He ingested the medicine with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水吞下了药。
words.en: Taken into the body through the mouth and swallowed, especially referring to food, drink, or medicine.

words.ex: He won a fortune in the lottery.
words.ex_cn: 他在彩票中赢得了一笔财富。

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.ex: A snake is a reptile.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种爬行动物。
words.en: A reptile is a cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia, including snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are characterized by their scaly skin and the fact that they lay eggs on land.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.tr: phrase. 与…形成对比；与…截然不同；相比之下
words.ex: In contrast with his brother, he is very quiet.
words.ex_cn: 与他的兄弟相比，他非常安静。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.ex: Eating a varied diet helps you stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃多样化的饮食有助于你保持健康。

words.ex: Lions and wolves are predators.
words.ex_cn: 狮子和狼是食肉动物。
words.en: Predators are animals that naturally prey on others.

words.ex: The lake is a man-made pond.
words.ex_cn: 这个湖是一个人工池塘。
words.en: Made or caused by human beings rather than occurring naturally.

words.ex: The ship uses GPS for navigation.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用GPS进行导航。
words.en: The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 埃菲尔铁塔是巴黎著名的地标。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a place that is easily recognized and can be used to judge your position or the position of other buildings or features.

words.tr: phrase. 交配习性；繁殖行为模式
words.ex: Birds change their mating habits in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天改变它们的交配习性。
words.en: The behaviors and patterns associated with the process of reproduction in animals.

words.ex: They are monogamous and have been married for 20 years.
words.ex_cn: 他们是专一的，已经结婚20年了。
words.en: Being monogamous means having only one sexual partner at a time.

words.tr: v. 孵化；孵出；孵化( hatch的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The eggs hatched after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这些蛋在三周后孵化了。
words.en: If an egg hatches or if it is hatched, it breaks open and a baby bird, fish, insect, or other animal comes out. If you hatch a plot or a scheme, you plan it secretly.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr: n. 自卫；自保；自我保护
words.ex: The animal acted out of self-preservation when it ran away from the predator.
words.ex_cn: 当动物从捕食者身边逃跑时，它是出于自卫。
words.en: Self-preservation is the instinctive behavior that protects an organism from harm or death.

words.tr: phrase. 书面证据；文件证据（指以书面形式存在的、用于证明事实的材料，如合同、信件、账单等）
words.ex: The police found documentary evidence in the file.
words.ex_cn: 警察在文件中找到了书面证据。
words.en: Documentary evidence refers to evidence that is presented in the form of documents, such as contracts, letters, or official records, which are used in legal proceedings to prove facts.

words.tr: adj. 栽培的；耕作的； v. 栽培；“cultivate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The cultivated vegetables taste better than wild ones.
words.ex_cn: 栽培的蔬菜比野生的更好吃。
words.en: If you describe someone as cultivated, you mean they are well educated and have good manners.

words.ex: He has a monopoly on selling ice cream in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他在这座小镇上垄断了冰淇淋的销售。
words.en: If a company, person, or state has a monopoly on something such as an industry, they have complete control over it, so that it is impossible for others to become involved in it.

words.ex: The workers live on large plantations.
words.ex_cn: 工人们住在大型种植园里。
words.en: A plantation is a large piece of land, especially in a tropical country, where crops such as coffee, sugar, rubber, etc. are grown.

words.tr: v. 突升；猛涨；突升，猛涨( skyrocket的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The price of bread skyrocketed last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月面包的价格突升了。
words.en: Increased rapidly and dramatically to a very high level.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动制度；劳工体系
words.ex: The labour system in this country is quite advanced.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的劳动制度相当先进。
words.en: The organized system of work and employment within a society or industry.

words.ex: The peasants worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 农民们每天在田里劳作。
words.en: Peasants are poor people of low social status who work on the land, used especially in the past or in reference to less developed countries.

words.tr: phrase. 税收手段；征税方式
words.ex: The government uses income tax as a means of taxation.
words.ex_cn: 政府将所得税作为税收手段。

words.tr: phrase. 奢侈品；高档消费品
words.ex: For many people, a private jet is considered a luxury item.
words.ex_cn: 对许多人来说，私人飞机被视为奢侈品。
words.en: A luxury item is something that is not necessary but is very expensive and enjoyable.

words.tr: phrase. 认同；将自己与…联系起来
words.ex: He identified with the struggles of the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他认同穷人的困境。

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；“prefer”的过去式或过去分词；
words.ex: She preferred tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: Liked or wanted more than anything else; chosen in preference to others.

words.ex: Caffeine is a common stimulant.
words.ex_cn: 咖啡因是一种常见的兴奋剂。
words.en: A stimulant is a substance that raises levels of physiological or nervous activity in the body.

words.ex: The farmer's cultivation of rice takes months.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植水稻需要几个月的时间。
words.en: The process of trying to acquire or develop a quality or skill.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The library digitalised all its old books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆将所有旧书数字化了。
words.en: To convert (information) into digital form.

words.tr: adj. 过时的；废弃的；淘汰的；
words.ex: This phone is obsolete because it doesn't work with new apps.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机已经过时了，因为它不能使用新应用。
words.en: Something that is obsolete is no longer needed because something better has been invented.

words.ex: He owns the copyright to his novel.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这部小说的版权。
words.en: The exclusive legal right, given to an originator or an assignee to print, publish, perform, film, or record literary, artistic, or musical material, and to authorize others to do the same.

words.ex: The library keeps old newspapers in an archive.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧报纸保存在档案馆里。
words.en: A collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: The two companies worked together in collaboration.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司通过合作一起工作。
words.en: the act of working together with someone to produce or create something

words.tr:
v. 回火；适得其反
n. 逆火
words.ex: The engine backfired when he pressed the gas pedal.
words.ex_cn: 当他踩下油门时，发动机回火了。
words.en: If a plan or project backfires, it has the opposite result to the one that was intended.

words.ex: The medicine has some side effects.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有一些副作用。
words.en: Unintended effects of a drug or treatment that occur along with the desired effect.

words.ex: There is an inconsistency between his words and actions.
words.ex_cn: 他的言行不一致。
words.en: The quality or state of being inconsistent; lack of consistency.

words.ex: His industriousness helps him finish work early.
words.ex_cn: 他的勤奋让他能早早完成工作。
words.en: The quality of being hard-working and diligent.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.tr: phrase. 思维清晰；理智上的透彻与明确
words.ex: The professor's lecture provided intellectual clarity on the complex subject.
words.ex_cn: 教授的讲座在这个复杂主题上提供了智力上的清晰度。
words.en: The ability to think clearly and logically, especially in complex situations, leading to well-reasoned judgments.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.ex: This company commands a large market share in smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司占据了智能手机市场的很大份额。

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.tr: phrase. v. 度过难关；勉强应付；勉强维持生活
words.ex: He gets by with little money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠很少的钱维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have.

words.ex: He earned a master's degree in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了工程学的硕士学位。
words.en: A master's degree is an advanced academic degree awarded by universities or colleges upon completion of a course of study demonstrating mastery or a high-order overview of a specific field of study or area of professional practice.

words.tr:
adj. 斯堪的纳维亚（人）的；
n. 斯堪的纳维亚人（语）；
words.ex: He enjoys Scandinavian music and cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢斯堪的纳维亚音乐和寒冷的天气。
words.en: Relating to Scandinavia, its people, or their languages.

words.ex: He loves reading old sagas about heroes.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读关于英雄的古老传说。
words.en: A long, detailed story of heroic or legendary events.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.ex: His provocative words made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他挑衅的话让所有人都生气了。
words.en: If you describe something as provocative, you mean that it is intended to make people react angrily or argue against it.

words.tr: phrase. 令人震惊的状况；骇人听闻的条件
words.ex: The workers lived in appalling conditions with no clean water.
words.ex_cn: 工人们生活在令人震惊的状况中，连干净的水都没有。
words.en: Extremely bad or shocking living or working environments.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.ex: He is bullying his little brother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在欺负他的弟弟。
words.en: The use of strength or influence to harm or intimidate those who are weaker.

words.ex: He spoke abusively to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他暴虐地对孩子们说话。
words.en: In a manner that involves the improper use or treatment of something, or that involves insulting or offensive language.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.tr: adj. 不兼容的；不相配的；
words.ex: The software is incompatible with old systems.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件与旧系统不兼容。
words.en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they are very different in important ways, and do not suit each other or agree with each other.

words.ex: He is pessimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持悲观态度。
words.en: If someone is pessimistic, they expect that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result.

words.ex: The bridge has a strong structural design.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构设计。
words.en: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr: phrase. （情况、事件等）急剧恶化，失去控制
words.ex: The situation can spiral out of control if we do not act now.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们现在不采取行动，情况可能会失控。
words.en: To become increasingly chaotic, unmanageable, or severe, often leading to a crisis.

words.ex: The autocratic leader made all decisions without asking others.
words.ex_cn: 这位独裁的领导人独自做出所有决定，从不询问他人。
words.en: If you describe someone as autocratic, you are criticizing them because they have complete power and make decisions without asking anyone else's advice.

words.ex: The journalist was seen as the mouthpiece of the government.
words.ex_cn: 这位记者被视为政府的喉舌。
words.en: A mouthpiece is a part of a musical instrument, telephone, or other device that you put in or near your mouth. It can also refer to a person, newspaper, etc., that expresses the opinions and policies of a government or organization.

words.ex: The mediator helped the two sides reach an agreement.
words.ex_cn: 调解人帮助双方达成了协议。
words.en: A mediator is a person who tries to end a disagreement by helping the two sides to talk about and agree on a solution.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书；工具书；参考资料书籍
words.ex: He uses reference books to find answers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用参考书来找答案。
words.en: Books intended to be consulted for authoritative information rather than read through.

words.ex: The community room is open every evening.
words.ex_cn: 社区活动室每天晚上都开放。
words.en: A shared space within a building, such as a library or community centre, designed for group activities and meetings.

words.tr: phrase. v. 出租；把……租出去；受雇于他人提供服务
words.ex: They hire out bikes near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园附近出租自行车。
words.en: To allow someone to use something temporarily in exchange for money; to work for someone temporarily in exchange for money.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the science lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在科学实验室做实验。
words.en: A scientific test or procedure carried out under controlled conditions to discover, demonstrate, or test a hypothesis, theory, or known law.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.tr: 它支持（指某物或某系统提供支持、支撑或技术支持等）
words.ex: This software it support older devices.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件支持旧设备。
words.en: Technical assistance and maintenance for computer systems, software, and networks.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 胆固醇水平；血液中胆固醇的含量
words.ex: His cholesterol levels are too high.
words.ex_cn: 他的胆固醇水平太高了。
words.en: The amount of cholesterol present in the blood, which can be an indicator of heart health.

words.ex: The teacher put up wallcharts in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里挂上了墙报。
words.en: A wallchart is a large piece of paper with diagrams or information on it, designed to be hung on a wall for reference or decoration.

words.tr: phrase. 个案研究；案例分析；调查研究
words.ex: He did a case study on a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于小企业的案例研究。
words.en: A case study is a detailed examination of a particular case or situation, especially in order to understand its complexities or to test a theory.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: He keeps a record of his daily expenses.
words.ex_cn: 他记录每天的开销。
words.en: To maintain a written or digital log of information for future reference.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.ex: Social media trends change quickly.
words.ex_cn: 社交媒体的趋势变化很快。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: The children noticed regularities in the number patterns.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们注意到了数字模式中的规律。
words.en: Regularities refer to the state or quality of being regular, consistent, or uniform in pattern or arrangement.

words.ex: He draws graphs to show the data.
words.ex_cn: 他画图表来展示数据。
words.en: A diagram that represents the variation of a variable in comparison with that of one or more other variables.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: There are potential problems with the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 这个新计划可能存在一些问题。
words.en: Possible issues or difficulties that may arise in the future, but have not yet occurred.

words.ex: He made an investment in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一家小企业。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest in something.

words.tr: phrase. 环境影响；对自然环境造成的后果或作用
words.ex: The factory caused a big environmental impact.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂造成了巨大的环境影响。
words.en: The effect that a company's or individual's actions have on the natural world, especially the negative effects.

words.ex: The game has age restrictions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有年龄约束。
words.en: Restrictions are rules or laws that limit what you can do or what can happen.

words.tr: n. 改写本；改编的作品；“adaptation”的复数；
words.ex: The school uses simple adaptations of classic novels for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生使用经典小说的简易改写本。
words.en: Adaptations are changes in an organism or its parts that make it better suited to survive and reproduce in its environment.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.tr: adj. 忠实的；虔诚的；可靠的；
words.ex: He is a faithful friend who always helps me.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是帮助我的忠实朋友。
words.en: Someone who is faithful remains loyal to a person, belief, or cause, and continues to support them.

words.ex: He edited the video with many clips.
words.ex_cn: 他用许多剪辑编辑了视频。
words.en: Clips can refer to short sections of a film or video, or to small devices used to hold things together. As a verb, it means to cut something with scissors or a similar tool, or to reduce the amount of something.

words.ex: The news reported many issues last week.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道了上周的许多事件。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are discussing or arguing about.

words.tr: n. 爱国主义；爱国精神；
words.ex: He showed patriotism by serving his country in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在军队中为国家服务表现出爱国主义。
words.en: Patriotism is the love and devotion to one's country.

words.tr: phrase. 松散改编；不拘泥于原作的改编版本
words.ex: The movie is a loose adaptation of the book.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是这本书的松散改编。
words.en: A version of a story or work that is not strictly faithful to the original.

words.tr: phrase. 互相争斗、长期不和的家族或家庭
words.ex: The two feuding families never spoke to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个争吵的家族从不互相说话。
words.en: Families engaged in a long-standing, bitter conflict or rivalry.

words.ex: The ad was designed for a commercial audience.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告是为商业观众设计的。

words.tr: adj. 革新的；富有革新精神的；
words.ex: The company made an innovative phone.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司推出了一款革新的手机。
words.en: Something that is innovative is new and original, especially in the way that it is done.

words.ex: She blends flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To mix substances together so that they combine into a single substance.

words.tr: n. 音响；声学；音响效果；
words.ex: The room has good acoustics for music.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的音响效果适合音乐。
words.en: Acoustics is the scientific study of sound, including its production, transmission, and effects.

words.tr: phrase. 城市声景；指城市环境中各种声音构成的整体听觉景观
words.ex: The city plays urban soundscapes in public parks.
words.ex_cn: 城市在公园里播放城市声景。
words.en: The auditory environment of a city, including all sounds from traffic, people, and industry.

words.ex: The loud music was 90 decibels.
words.ex_cn: 那首音乐很响，有90分贝。
words.en: A decibel is a unit used to measure the intensity of a sound or the power level of an electrical signal by comparing it with a given level on a logarithmic scale.

words.ex: His perceptions of success are different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对成功的观念与我的不同。
words.en: The way in which something is regarded, understood, or interpreted.

words.ex: The company must follow the safety regulations.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须遵守安全条例。
words.en: Regulations are rules or laws designed to control the way that something happens or is done.

words.tr: phrase. 被打断的睡眠；睡眠不连贯
words.ex: He had interrupted sleep because of loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他因为噪音而睡眠被打断。

words.tr: n. 构成；作曲；（学生）作文；创作技巧；
words.ex: The composition of the rock includes sand and clay.
words.ex_cn: 这种岩石的构成包括沙子和黏土。
words.en: The way in which something is composed or arranged; the act of creating something, especially a piece of writing or music.

words.ex: Can you differentiate between the two colors?
words.ex_cn: 你能区分这两种颜色吗？
words.en: To differentiate means to recognize or express the difference between things or people.

words.ex: His intrusive questions made her uncomfortable.
words.ex_cn: 他打搅的问题让她感到不舒服。
words.en: Something that is intrusive disturbs your privacy or peace in an unwanted way.

words.tr: adj. 各学科间的；跨学科的；
words.ex: The project is interdisciplinary, combining biology and chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是跨学科的，结合了生物学和化学。
words.en: Involving two or more academic, scientific, or artistic disciplines.

words.ex: His words were contradictory.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: If two or more facts, ideas, or statements are contradictory, they state or imply that opposite things are true.

words.tr: phrase. 审美品质；美学质量
words.ex: The painting has high aesthetic quality.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画具有很高的审美品质。
words.en: Aesthetic quality refers to the degree to which an object or a work of art is considered beautiful or pleasing in appearance.

words.ex: Math and science are important disciplines in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学和科学是学校里重要的学科。
words.en: Disciplines refer to a branch of knowledge, typically one studied in higher education, or the practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behavior, using punishment to correct disobedience.

words.ex: He is wearing a headset to experience virtual reality.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着头盔体验虚拟现实。
words.en: Virtual reality is an artificial environment that is created with software and presented to the user in such a way that the user suspends belief and accepts it as a real environment.

words.tr: phrase. 主修科目；主修专业
words.ex: His major subject is biology.
words.ex_cn: 他的主修科目是生物学。
words.en: The primary field of study or main topic in an academic course or degree.

words.tr: phrase. 辅修科目；副修课程
words.ex: He took music as a minor subject in university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学把音乐作为辅修科目。
words.en: A subject or field of study chosen by a student to be secondary to their major field of study.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.tr: n. 生物体；有机体；有机组织；
words.ex: A bacterium is a simple organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种简单的生物体。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has an organized structure, can react to stimuli, reproduce, grow, adapt, and maintain homeostasis.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.ex: The wave speed is 340 meters per second in air.
words.ex_cn: 在空气中，波速是每秒340米。
words.en: The rate at which a wave, such as a sound or light wave, travels through a medium.

words.tr: phrase. 岩石池；潮汐池（指海岸岩石间因退潮而形成的水池）
words.ex: The children found a rock pool with small fish.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们发现了一个有小鱼的潮水池。
words.en: A rock pool is a small pool of seawater that is found among rocks on the shore.

words.ex: The lab technician will analyse samples from the patients.
words.ex_cn: 实验室技术员将分析患者的样本。

words.tr: phrase. 按比例；按比例尺；与……成比例
words.ex: The map is drawn to scale.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图是按比例绘制的。
words.en: In proportion or to the correct size.

words.ex: The children play in the splash zone at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的溅水区玩耍。
words.en: An area where water is likely to splash, especially in a water park or near a fountain.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: The wave action along the coast is eroding the cliffs.
words.ex_cn: 海岸边的波浪作用正在侵蚀悬崖。
words.en: The movement of waves, especially as it affects the shoreline or objects in the water.

words.tr: phrase. 误差来源；错误根源
words.ex: The dirty sensor is a source of error in the measurement.
words.ex_cn: 脏污的传感器是测量中的误差来源。

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.ex: The procession moved slowly down the street.
words.ex_cn: 行列缓缓沿着街道行进。
words.en: A procession is a group of people who are walking, riding, or driving in a line as part of a public event.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.ex: He wrote a book about ethnography of the tribe.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于这个部落的人种学的书。
words.en: Ethnography is the systematic study of people and cultures. It is designed to explore cultural phenomena where the researcher observes society from the point of view of the subject of the study.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.tr: n. 态度；姿势（复数形式）；
words.ex: His attitudes toward homework are very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, especially as shown by your behavior.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；“entrepreneur”的复数；
words.ex: Entrepreneurs start new businesses to make money.
words.ex_cn: 企业家创办新企业来赚钱。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who sets up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.

words.ex: The administrators fixed the website error.
words.ex_cn: 管理员修复了网站的错误。
words.en: Administrators are people whose job is to manage and organize the affairs of a business or institution.

words.ex: He uses a spreadsheet to count his money.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子表格来计算他的钱。
words.en: A spreadsheet is a computer program that is used for displaying and dealing with numbers. It shows numbers in rows and columns, and it is used especially for doing financial calculations and for creating graphs.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.tr: n. 被调查者；受访者；“respondent”的复数；
words.ex: The respondents answered the survey questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 被调查者诚实地回答了调查问题。
words.en: Respondents are people who reply to something such as a survey or questionnaire.

words.tr: n. 标准；尺度；准则；“criterion”的复数；
words.ex: The main criteria for selection are skill and experience.
words.ex_cn: 选择的主要标准是技能和经验。
words.en: A criterion is a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.tr: adj. 令人信服的； v. “compel”的现在分词；
words.ex: His story was compelling and made everyone listen.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事令人信服，让所有人都认真聆听。
words.en: A compelling argument or reason is one that makes you believe it or accept it because it is so strong.

words.tr: phrase. 志愿者计划；志愿项目
words.ex: He joined a volunteer scheme to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个志愿项目来帮助穷人。
words.en: An organized plan or program for unpaid work, often for community benefit.

words.tr: phrase. 社区意识；群体意识；归属感
words.ex: The small town has a strong sense of community.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有着强烈的社区归属感。
words.en: The feeling of belonging to a group and being involved in a community.

words.ex: The doctor gave me some health recommendations.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我一些健康建议。
words.en: Recommendations are suggestions or proposals about the best course of action to take, especially those given by someone in authority or with expertise.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.tr: phrase. 社区团体；社区组织
words.ex: Community groups meet every week to help neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 社区团体每周聚会帮助邻居。
words.en: Community groups are organizations formed by members of a community to work towards a common goal or interest.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.tr: v. 更新；“update”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 最新的；更新的；
words.ex: He updated his phone software yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天更新了手机软件。
words.en: Made more modern or up to date.

words.ex: The concerts will be held at different venues across the city.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会将在城市的不同场地举行。
words.en: A venue is the place where an event or meeting happens.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.tr: 短时间通知；临时通知；在短时间内
words.ex: He left the job at short notice.
words.ex_cn: 他突然辞职了。
words.en: With little advance warning or time for preparation.

words.ex: The boy is behaving badly in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上表现得很糟糕。
words.en: Acting in a rude, disobedient, or socially unacceptable manner.

words.ex: The school is doing timetabling for next term.
words.ex_cn: 学校正在为下个学期安排课程表。
words.en: The process of scheduling or planning events, tasks, or activities according to a timetable.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或出版等）的；准备好的；
words.ex: The forthcoming book will be released next month.
words.ex_cn: 即将出版的这本书将在下个月发布。
words.en: If something is forthcoming, it is happening or coming soon.

words.tr: phrase. 签约参加工作；签约雇用；报名
words.ex: He signed up for a job at the local factory.
words.ex_cn: 他签约参加了当地工厂的工作。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity or to join a group or organization.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.tr: phrase. 任命书；委任书；聘书
words.ex: She received her letter of appointment as the new CEO yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天收到了她作为新任CEO的任命书。
words.en: A formal document issued by an organization to officially appoint someone to a position.

words.ex: He wears a badge on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他衬衫上戴着一枚徽章。
words.en: A badge is a small piece of metal, plastic, or cloth which you wear in order to show people that you have a particular rank, job, or belong to a particular group.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.tr: phrase. 人力资源部门（负责招聘、培训、薪酬福利、员工关系等事务的公司部门）
words.ex: The hr department hired a new employee.
words.ex_cn: 人力资源部门雇了一名新员工。
words.en: The department within an organization responsible for employee management.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.tr: phrase. 面包区；糕点区（指超市或商店中专门售卖面包、蛋糕等烘焙食品的区域）
words.ex: The bakery section was filled with the aroma of freshly baked bread.
words.ex_cn: 面包糕点区充满了新鲜出炉面包的香气。
words.en: A designated area in a store where bread, cakes, and pastries are sold.

words.ex: The milk passed its sell-by date.
words.ex_cn: 这瓶牛奶超过了最佳销售日期。
words.en: The last date by which a product should be sold, as stated by the manufacturer, after which it might not be at its best quality.

words.ex: The price label shows five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 价格标签上标着五美元。
words.en: A price label is a piece of paper or other material that is attached to a product, showing how much the product costs.

words.ex: I ordered sushi from the takeaway counter near the station.
words.ex_cn: 我在车站附近的寿司外卖柜台点了寿司。

words.ex: The teacher keeps extra books in the storeroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师把多余的书放在贮藏室里。
words.en: A room or area where items are stored.

words.ex: He put the apple on the weighing scales.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果放在秤上。
words.en: A weighing scale is a device for measuring weight, especially one that is used to measure how heavy a person or thing is.

words.ex: The fruits are stored in a cold-room.
words.ex_cn: 水果存放在冷库里。
words.en: A cold-room is a room where the temperature is kept very low, used for storing food or other items that need to be kept cold.

words.tr: phrase. 保暖手套；用于防寒或隔热的手套
words.ex: He wears thermal gloves in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他在冬天戴保暖手套。
words.en: Thermal gloves are gloves designed to keep the hands warm, especially in cold weather. They are made from materials that provide insulation against the cold.

words.ex: He got frostbite on his fingers after playing in the snow too long.
words.ex_cn: 他在雪地里玩太久，手指冻伤了。
words.en: Frostbite is an injury caused by freezing of the skin and underlying tissues.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.tr: phrase. 工作经验；职业经历
words.ex: He has work experience in a restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他在餐厅有工作经验。
words.en: Work experience refers to the knowledge and skills that someone has gained through working in a particular job or field.

words.ex: Steve Jobs is the founder of Apple.
words.ex_cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是苹果公司的创办者。
words.en: A founder is someone who establishes an organization, company, or institution. As a verb, it means to fail or collapse, especially in terms of a plan or a ship sinking.

words.ex: He completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了木工学徒期。
words.en: An apprenticeship is a period of time in which someone learns a trade or profession by working under the supervision of a skilled worker.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车工业；汽车制造业
words.ex: The automotive industry makes cars and trucks.
words.ex_cn: 汽车行业制造汽车和卡车。
words.en: The automotive industry refers to the range of companies and organizations involved in the design, development, manufacturing, marketing, and selling of motor vehicles. It is one of the world's largest economic sectors by revenue.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗保健行业；健康产业
words.ex: He works in the healthcare industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在医疗行业工作。
words.en: The healthcare industry refers to the sector of the economy that provides medical services, products, and technologies to maintain and improve health.

words.tr: n. （企业或机构使用的）房屋及土地；“premise”的复数；
words.ex: The company owns its premises in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司拥有位于市中心的房产和土地。
words.en: The buildings and land that a business or organization uses.

words.tr: n. 改造（工程）；建筑改造；整修；
words.ex: The refurbishment of the old school took six months.
words.ex_cn: 这所旧学校的改造工程花了六个月。
words.en: The process of repairing and redecorating something, especially a building, to make it more attractive or functional.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己熟悉（新环境）；为自己确定方向；使自己适应
words.ex: Please orientate yourselves to the new classroom.
words.ex_cn: 请适应一下新教室。
words.en: To orientate yourselves means to familiarize yourself with a new situation or environment.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.tr: phrase. 通道道路；出入道路（连接主干道与建筑物、停车场等的专用道路）
words.ex: The access road to the highway was closed for construction.
words.ex_cn: 通往高速公路的支线道路因施工而关闭。
words.en: A road leading to a particular destination, especially one providing access for vehicles to a building, facility, or area.

words.ex: The managers met in the boardroom to discuss the plan.
words.ex_cn: 经理们在会议室里讨论计划。
words.en: A boardroom is a room where the board of directors of a company meets.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: He works in a clerical job at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做文书工作。
words.en: Clerical means relating to work that is done in an office, especially work that involves keeping records or accounts. It can also refer to the clergy or the religious leaders of a church.

words.ex: The admin office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政部门负责管理学校档案。
words.en: An admin is someone whose job involves managing the work of a company or organization.

words.ex: The company hired temporary staff for the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 公司为假期季节雇佣了临时工。
words.en: Temporary staff refers to employees who are hired on a non-permanent basis to meet the short-term needs of a business or organization.

words.ex: The health sector needs more funding.
words.ex_cn: 医疗部门需要更多资金。
words.en: A particular area of activity, especially one that is part of a larger area of activity or one that is considered separately from other areas.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 每小时的费率；时薪
words.ex: He earns an hourly rate of $15.
words.ex_cn: 他每小时赚15美元。
words.en: The amount of money charged or earned per hour of work.

words.tr: phrase. 注册流程；登记程序
words.ex: He completed the registration process last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了注册流程。
words.en: The series of steps required to officially enroll or apply for something, often involving forms and checks.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: phrase. 顾客服务部门；负责处理客户咨询、投诉和售后服务的部门
words.ex: He called the customer services department for help.
words.ex_cn: 他打电话给客户服务部门寻求帮助。
words.en: The customer services department is the division of a company that is responsible for assisting customers with their inquiries, complaints, and other service-related issues.

words.tr: phrase. 初始培训；入职培训；初期训练
words.ex: He completed his initial training last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月完成了初始培训。
words.en: The first stage of training provided to new employees or members to familiarize them with their roles and responsibilities.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: He looks for new opportunities every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在寻找新的机会。
words.en: A time or set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something.

words.ex: He earns the minimum wage at the grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店赚取最低工资。
words.en: The lowest wage permitted by law or by a special agreement (such as one with a labor union).

words.tr: phrase. 获得信心；增强自信
words.ex: He gains confidence after practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习后增强了信心。
words.en: To acquire or develop self-assurance.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport in plenty of time.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.ex: The courier delivered the letter quickly.
words.ex_cn: 信使迅速送来了这封信。
words.en: A courier is a person or company that delivers messages, packages, and mail.

words.tr: adj. 感到宽慰的； v. 缓解；“relieve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt relieved when he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 当他通过考试时，他感到宽慰。
words.en: If you are relieved, you feel happy because something unpleasant has not happened or is no longer happening.

words.ex: She gave a cheerful smile.
words.ex_cn: 她露出了快乐的微笑。
words.en: Someone who is cheerful is happy and shows this in their behavior.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.ex: Many carers feel overwhelmed by the demands of looking after a loved one.
words.ex_cn: 许多照顾者因照顾亲人的需求而感到不堪重负。
words.en: A carer is someone who looks after a sick or disabled person, often without being paid.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: He copes with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To cope with a problem or task means to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 要求；索取（赔偿、权利等）
words.ex: He claimed for compensation after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他要求赔偿。
words.en: To ask for something because you think it belongs to you or because you think you have a right to it.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimise waste in your daily life.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you minimise a risk, problem, or unpleasant situation, you reduce it to the lowest possible level, or prevent it increasing beyond that level.

words.ex: The air quality is bad today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的空气质量很差。
words.en: The condition of the air in a particular place, especially in relation to how clean or polluted it is.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.ex: He works for an insurance company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家保险公司工作。
words.en: A company that provides insurance policies to individuals or businesses to protect against financial loss.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.tr: adj. 全部时间的；专任的
words.ex: He works full-time at a grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家杂货店全职工作。
words.en: If you are a full-time worker, you work the normal number of hours or days in a week.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.ex: He gradually learned to ride a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渐渐学会了骑自行车。
words.en: If something changes or is done gradually, it changes or is done in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: Apply heat to the metal until it melts.
words.ex_cn: 给金属施加热量，直到它熔化。

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: He exercises on a regular basis.
words.ex_cn: 他定期锻炼。
words.en: If something happens on a regular basis, it happens repeatedly, often at fixed times.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.tr: phrase. 积极的经历；正面体验；愉快的体验
words.ex: He had a positive experience at the new school.
words.ex_cn: 他在新学校有一段积极的经历。
words.en: A positive experience refers to an event or situation that is beneficial, enjoyable, or leads to personal growth.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.tr: adj. 印象深刻的； v. 使印象深刻；“impress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was impressed by her kindness.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良给我留下了深刻的印象。
words.en: If you are impressed by something or someone, you feel great admiration for them.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr: phrase. 素食菜肴；指不含肉类或鱼类的餐点
words.ex: She cooks vegetarian dishes every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都做素食菜肴。
words.en: Dishes that are made without any meat or fish, often emphasizing vegetables, grains, and sometimes dairy products or eggs.

words.ex: The selection of books was very good.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的选择非常好。
words.en: The act of carefully choosing someone or something as the best or most suitable.

words.tr: adj. 值得纪念的；难忘的；
words.ex: That vacation was a memorable trip.
words.ex_cn: 那次旅行是一次值得纪念的旅程。
words.en: Something that is memorable is worth remembering or likely to be remembered, because it is special or very enjoyable.

words.ex: The company sourced fresh materials from local farms.
words.ex_cn: 公司从本地农场获得了新鲜材料。
words.en: To obtain or procure from a particular source.

words.tr: phrase. 套餐午餐；固定菜单的午餐
words.ex: He eats set lunch at noon every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天中午吃套餐午餐。
words.en: A fixed-price meal, typically offered at lunchtime, consisting of a limited selection of dishes, often including a main course, side, and drink.

words.ex: The cost is $10 a head for the meal.
words.ex_cn: 这顿饭每人10美元。
words.en: The leader or person in charge of an organization or group.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.tr: phrase. 走失；偏离；漫无目的地走开
words.ex: The child wandered off while playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在公园里玩耍时走丢了。
words.en: To leave a place or person without permission or without telling anyone.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.tr: adj. 自我引导的；自助式的；无需指导的
words.ex: He took a self-guided tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了自助式博物馆参观。
words.en: Operating without a human guide or operator.

words.ex: He listens to music with headphones.
words.ex_cn: 他用耳机听音乐。
words.en: Headphones are a pair of small speakers that you wear over your ears in order to listen to music or other sounds without other people hearing them.

words.tr: n. 重建；再发展；重建发展；
words.ex: The city plans redevelopment of the old downtown.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划对旧市中心进行重建。
words.en: The process of improving an area by building new houses, shops, or factories, or by repairing old ones.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.ex: He pulled the crossbar to lock the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拉上门闩来锁门。
words.en: A crossbar is a horizontal bar, especially one that is part of a structure such as a goal in football, or a bicycle.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.ex: We had a barbecue in the park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们在公园举行了户外烧烤。
words.en: A barbecue is a meal or gathering at which meat, fish, or other food is cooked out of doors on a rack over an open fire or on a special appliance.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.tr: n. 小巴；小型公共汽车；
words.ex: The children took the minibus to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐小巴去学校。
words.en: A minibus is a small bus, usually one that carries fewer than twenty passengers.

words.ex: She works for a voluntary organisation that helps homeless people.
words.ex_cn: 她为一个帮助无家可归者的志愿组织工作。
words.en: A voluntary organisation is a group of people who work together to achieve a common goal without being paid for their work.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: The reliability of this car is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的可靠性很高。
words.en: The quality of being trustworthy or consistent in performance.

words.tr:
adj. 面对面的
adv. 面对面地
words.ex: We talk face-to-face every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每个星期天都面对面交谈。
words.en: Involving direct contact or confrontation between individuals.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.ex: His dedication to teaching helped many students succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他对教学的奉献帮助了许多学生取得成功。
words.en: The act of dedicating or the state of being dedicated; commitment.

words.ex: The school held a bake sale for fundraising.
words.ex_cn: 学校举办了一个烘焙义卖来筹款。
words.en: Fundraising is the activity of collecting money to support a charity or political campaign or organization.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾收集；废弃物收集
words.ex: Volunteers did litter collection in the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者在公园里进行了垃圾收集。
words.en: The act of collecting waste materials from public places to maintain cleanliness and hygiene.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr: phrase. 弱势群体；易受伤害的群体
words.ex: The government helps vulnerable groups with food and medicine.
words.ex_cn: 政府为弱势群体提供食物和药品。
words.en: People or communities particularly susceptible to harm or disadvantage.

words.ex: He gave first aid to the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 他给受伤的人进行了急救。
words.en: Immediate assistance given to a person suffering from either a minor or serious illness or injury, with care provided to preserve life, prevent the condition from worsening, or to promote recovery.

words.ex: He filled out the application form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了申请表。
words.en: A document used to apply for something, such as a job or membership, by providing personal information and details.

words.ex: My family name is Li.
words.ex_cn: 我的姓是李。
words.en: Your family name is the name that you share with other members of your family. In English-speaking countries, it is often called the 'last name' or 'surname'.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.ex: Children learn to socialise at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校学习进行社交活动。
words.en: To socialise means to participate or to cause someone to participate in social activities; to make someone behave in a way that is acceptable to their society.

words.tr: n. 会员资格；全体会员；
words.ex: He paid $50 to get membership of the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了50美元以获得健身房的会员资格。
words.en: Membership is the state of being a member of a group or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 准会员资格；附属会员身份
words.ex: He has associate membership in the professional society.
words.ex_cn: 他是该专业协会的准会员。
words.en: A type of membership that grants limited rights and privileges, often without full voting or decision-making power.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭生活；日常生活
words.ex: He enjoys a quiet domestic life with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢和家人一起过平静的家庭生活。
words.en: Domestic life refers to the activities, relationships, and experiences that occur within the home or family setting.

words.tr: n. 构成；作曲；（学生）作文；创作技巧；
words.ex: The composition of the rock includes sand and clay.
words.ex_cn: 这种岩石的构成包括沙子和黏土。
words.en: The way in which something is composed or arranged; the act of creating something, especially a piece of writing or music.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.tr: n. 时间的安排；时间的选择； v. “time”的现在分词；
words.ex: The timing of the meeting was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 会议的时间安排恰到好处。
words.en: Timing is the skill or action of judging the right moment in a situation or activity at which to do something.

words.tr: v. 猜想；怀疑；“suspect”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被怀疑的；
words.ex: I suspected he was lying.
words.ex_cn: 我猜他撒谎了。
words.en: Believed to be guilty of a crime or wrongdoing, but not yet proven.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: The forest has high biodiversity.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林生物多样性很高。
words.en: Biodiversity refers to the variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: The fisherman walks on the beach at low tide.
words.ex_cn: 渔民在低潮时走在海滩上。
words.en: Low tide is the time when the sea is at its lowest level because the tide is out.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: Each participant must sign the form.
words.ex_cn: 每个参与者都必须签署表格。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in an activity or event.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.tr: v. 协调；使一致；安排；n. 协调；坐标
words.ex: He co-ordinates the team meetings every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一协调团队会议。
words.en: To organize and bring different elements into an effective relationship or operation.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: He donate money to the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他向贫困儿童捐赠钱。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization that needs help.

words.ex: The school uses computerised tests for math.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用计算机化的数学测试。
words.en: Made to operate by or through the use of computers; automated.

words.tr: adj. 为特定目的建造的
words.ex: The school is purpose-built for children with special needs.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是专门为有特殊需求的孩子建造的。
words.en: Designed and built for a specific purpose.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.tr: n. 除杂草； v. “weed”的现在分词；
words.ex: Weeding the garden takes most of my weekend.
words.ex_cn: 除杂草占用了我整个周末的时间。
words.en: The act of removing unwanted plants from a garden or other area.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭清洁的；与家务清洁相关的
words.ex: She uses domestic cleaning products to keep her home tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她使用家庭清洁产品来保持家里的整洁。
words.en: The act of cleaning the interior of a home or other residential building.

words.ex: We need to give the house a thorough clean before the guests arrive.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要在客人到来之前给房子彻底清洁。
words.en: A thorough clean refers to a complete and detailed cleaning process that leaves no area untouched.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.tr: phrase. 额外的服务；附加服务
words.ex: The hotel offers additional services like free breakfast and airport pickup.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店提供额外的服务，比如免费早餐和机场接送。
words.en: Extra or supplementary services offered beyond the basic package.

words.ex: The grubby child came in with dirty hands.
words.ex_cn: 那个脏兮兮的孩子带着脏手进来了。
words.en: If you describe something as grubby, you mean that it is dirty.

words.tr: phrase. 高压清洗机；高压水枪
