words.ex: He uses a pressure washer to clean the driveway.
words.ex_cn: 他用高压清洗机清洗车道。
words.en: A pressure washer is a high-pressure mechanical sprayer used to remove loose paint, mold, grime, dust, mud, and dirt from surfaces and objects such as buildings, vehicles and concrete surfaces.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.ex: This app will put you in touch with a local guide.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用会帮你联系到一位当地向导。
words.en: To connect someone with another person, typically for communication or assistance.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr: phrase. 接受安全检查；进行安检
words.ex: All passengers must undergo a security check before boarding the plane.
words.ex_cn: 所有乘客在登机前必须接受安全检查。
words.en: To undergo a security check means to be subjected to a process of examination to ensure safety and security.

words.ex: He has a criminal background.
words.ex_cn: 他有犯罪记录。
words.en: A criminal background refers to a person's history of criminal activity, which can affect their employment opportunities, housing, and other aspects of life.

words.tr: phrase. 提供参考资料；提供引文出处；提供推荐信
words.ex: He must provide references for his job application.
words.ex_cn: 他必须为他的工作申请提供推荐信。
words.en: To supply or give references, typically in the context of academic writing, research, or job applications.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.ex: The factory uses recycled materials to make new bottles.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用可再生材料制造新瓶子。
words.en: Materials that have been processed and converted into raw materials for new products.

words.tr: phrase. 动画制作软件；用于创建和编辑动画的计算机程序
words.ex: He uses animation software to make cartoon videos.
words.ex_cn: 他使用动画软件制作卡通视频。
words.en: Animation software refers to computer programs used to create animated images and videos.

words.ex: He will enrol in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将登记参加英语课程。
words.en: To officially arrange to join a school, university, or course, or to arrange for someone else to do this.

words.tr: phrase. 工业园区；工业用地
words.ex: The new industrial estate is expected to create hundreds of jobs.
words.ex_cn: 新的工业区预计将创造数百个就业机会。
words.en: An industrial estate is an area of land where industrial companies have their buildings.

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.tr: phrase. 数字格式；以数字形式存储的数据格式
words.ex: The book is available in digital format.
words.ex_cn: 这本书以数字格式提供。
words.en: A version of a document, image, or data stored in a form that can be processed by a computer.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: phrase. 修饰；润色；稍加改进（尤指绘画、照片或外观）
words.ex: He will touch up the painting before the show.
words.ex_cn: 他在展览前会稍微修饰一下这幅画。
words.en: To improve or finish something by making small changes or additions.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.tr: phrase. 清晰的；焦点对准的；处于关注中心的
words.ex: The cat is in focus in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 照片中的猫是清晰的。
words.en: If something is in focus, it is clearly defined and easy to see or understand.

words.tr: phrase. 自行车露营地；专为骑自行车者提供的露营地
words.ex: They go to cycle camp every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天去骑车夏令营。
words.en: A campsite or event where cycling activities and related social gatherings take place.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: He will stand in for the teacher today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天代替老师上课。
words.en: To take the place of someone or something temporarily.

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: The teacher spent hours preparing detailed lesson plans for the semester.
words.ex_cn: 老师花了几个小时为这学期准备详细的教案。
words.en: A lesson plan is a detailed description of the course of instruction or 'learning trajectory' for a lesson. It is developed by a teacher to guide class learning.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.ex: He put on his waterproofs before going out in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他出门下雨前穿上了雨衣。
words.en: To make something resistant to water; materials that are resistant to water.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.tr: v. 调整；使适合；使适应；
words.ex: He adjusted the chair to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了椅子以便坐得舒服。
words.en: To adjust something means to change it so that it is more effective or appropriate, or so that it fits better.

words.ex: The children play soccer on the recreation ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场踢足球。
words.en: A recreation ground is an area of land that is used for sports and other leisure activities.

words.tr: phrase. 板球场（用于板球比赛的长方形场地）
words.ex: The cricket pitch was meticulously prepared for the match.
words.ex_cn: 板球场为比赛精心准备。
words.en: The area of ground between the two wickets in the game of cricket, where the bowler delivers the ball to the batsman.

words.ex: Children walk on the footpath to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在人行道上步行去学校。
words.en: A footpath is a path that is designed for people to walk along, especially one in the countryside or a park.

words.tr: phrase. 滑板坡道；专为滑板运动设计的斜坡设施
words.ex: He practices tricks on the skateboard ramp.
words.ex_cn: 他在滑板坡道上练习特技。
words.en: A skateboard ramp is a structure used in skateboarding, which provides a slope for skateboarders to perform tricks.

words.ex: The fans sat in the pavilion to watch the game.
words.ex_cn: 观众坐在看台上观看比赛。
words.en: A pavilion is a building or tent used for a specific purpose, such as entertainment or exhibitions, often found in parks or at fairs.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.ex: The town holds a music festival every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天都举办音乐节。
words.en: A festival is an organized series of events such as musical concerts or drama productions, often happening annually in the same place.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.tr: phrase. 针对…的；以…为目标的
words.ex: The program is aimed at children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是针对儿童的。
words.en: directed at or intended for

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.tr: v. 监督，管理；监督，管理( supervise的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The teacher supervised the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

words.tr: phrase. 野外游泳；指在自然水域（如湖泊、河流、海洋）中而非游泳池内的游泳活动
words.ex: Wild swimming has become increasingly popular among outdoor enthusiasts.
words.ex_cn: n. 在自然水域中游泳的活动在户外爱好者中越来越受欢迎。
words.en: The activity of swimming in natural bodies of water such as rivers, lakes, or the sea.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.tr: phrase. 值班的；当值的；值勤的；在上班
words.ex: The nurse is on duty tonight.
words.ex_cn: 护士今晚在值班。
words.en: If someone is on duty, they are working at a particular time.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那只昆虫飞过了草地。
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.tr: n. 准备工作；配制剂；准备( preparation的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The preparations for the party took all weekend.
words.ex_cn: 派对的准备工作花了一整个周末。
words.en: The act or process of making something ready for use or consideration or for dealing with a particular situation.

words.ex: He writes a blog about travel.
words.ex_cn: 他写一个关于旅行的博客。
words.en: A blog is a website containing a writer's or group of writers' own experiences, observations, opinions, etc., and often having images and links to other websites.

words.ex: He wrote his postcode on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮编写在了信封上。
words.en: A postcode is a sequence of letters and numbers which is part of an address and shows exactly where a place is.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的曲径；
words.ex: The children got lost in the maze.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A maze is a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost.

words.tr:
n. 树篱；防范措施
v. 用树篱围住；限制；避免
words.ex: He planted a hedge around his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园周围种了一排树篱。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees which have been planted along the edge of a garden, field, or road to separate it from another area or to protect it. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid committing oneself or to limit or qualify something by conditions or exceptions.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: The triangle has a right-angle corner.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个直角。
words.en: An angle of 90°, as in a corner of a square or at the intersection of two perpendicular straight lines.

words.ex: He works out in the fitness area every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在健身区锻炼。
words.en: A fitness area is a designated space equipped with exercise machines and equipment for physical workouts.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.ex: The toddler is walking slowly by the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这个幼儿正慢慢地在沙发旁走路。
words.en: A toddler is a young child who has just learned to walk or who is learning to walk.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.tr: phrase. （系统、设备等）已启动并正常运行的；运作中的
words.ex: The new machine is up and running now.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器现在已经运行了。
words.en: If a system or machine is up and running, it is operating normally after being started or after it has stopped working.

words.tr: phrase. 志愿管理员；志愿看守员（复数）
words.ex: The volunteer wardens check the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者管理员每天早上检查公园。
words.en: People who give their time freely to help protect or manage a place, often without pay.

words.tr: phrase. v. 阻塞；封锁；隔开（某区域）
words.ex: They block off the street during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 他们在节日期间封锁街道。
words.en: To block off means to prevent access to an area or to close an area so that people or vehicles cannot enter.

words.ex: Through traffic is not allowed in this street.
words.ex_cn: 这条街上不允许过境车辆通行。
words.en: Traffic that passes through a place without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 有权使用；有机会接近
words.ex: He has access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: The ability or right to approach, enter, or make use of something.

words.ex: I will give it a go to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我会试着解决这个数学问题。
words.en: To make an attempt or try something, often with the hope of success.

words.tr: phrase. 大家庭；扩大的家庭（如数代同堂的家庭）
words.ex: He lives with his extended family in a big house.
words.ex_cn: 他和大家庭住在一起，住在一所大房子里。
words.en: A family group that consists of parents, children, and other close relatives, often living in close proximity.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.ex: We had a buffet lunch at the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店吃了自助午餐。
words.en: A buffet lunch is a meal where guests serve themselves from a variety of dishes set out on a table or sideboard.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.ex: The hotel has a large atrium with plants and sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有一个带植物和阳光的宽敞中庭。
words.en: An atrium is a part of the heart that receives blood from the veins, or a large open space within a building, often with a glass roof.

words.ex: The teacher turned on the projector to show the video.
words.ex_cn: 老师打开投影仪来播放视频。
words.en: A projector is a machine that projects films or slides onto a screen or wall.

words.ex: The restaurant offers a standard menu with burgers and fries.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供包含汉堡和薯条的普通菜单。
words.en: A fixed set of dishes offered at a restaurant for a set price, typically including a starter, main course, and dessert.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.tr: phrase. 坐着享用的正餐；正式用餐（区别于快餐或站立用餐）
words.ex: We had a sit-down meal at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃了一顿正餐。
words.en: A sit-down meal is a meal where guests are seated at tables and served food, as opposed to a buffet or standing reception.

words.ex: The house has a small terrace with chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带椅子的小平台。
words.en: A terrace is a flat area of stone or grass next to a building where people can sit.

words.tr: adj. 完备的；设施独立的；独立自足的；沉默寡言的
words.ex: The cabin is self-contained with its own water and electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个小屋是自给自足的，有自己独立的水和电。
words.en: A self-contained place or thing is complete and does not need other things to function or exist.

words.tr: n. 改造（工程）；建筑改造；整修；
words.ex: The refurbishment of the old school took six months.
words.ex_cn: 这所旧学校的改造工程花了六个月。
words.en: The process of repairing and redecorating something, especially a building, to make it more attractive or functional.

words.tr: phrase. 司仪；主持人；典礼官
words.ex: He is the master of ceremonies at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他是婚礼的主持人。
words.en: A master of ceremonies is a person who introduces speakers, performers, or events at a formal occasion such as a wedding or a public ceremony.

words.ex: He enjoys recreational activities like swimming and hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动。
words.en: Relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.tr:
v. 提升；提高；改进；
n. 增加；改进；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better performance.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更好的性能。
words.en: To upgrade means to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or to raise it to a higher standard. It can also refer to the process of improving or raising something.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: The cake was made to order for the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕是为生日派对特别定制的。
words.en: Custom-made or created specifically to meet a particular request or need.

words.tr: n. 新手；新手( novice的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The novices learned to swim in the shallow pool.
words.ex_cn: 新手们在浅水池里学习游泳。
words.en: People who are new to and inexperienced in a skill or activity.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 会合点；集合地点；会面地点
words.ex: The park is our meeting point at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 公园是我们下午五点的集合点。
words.en: A meeting point is a place where people arrange to meet.

words.ex: He tries to fit in with his new classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力融入新同学中。
words.en: If you fit in with a group of people, you are accepted by them because you are similar to them or because your behaviour is acceptable to them.

words.ex: They went to a social event last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚去参加了一个社交活动。
words.en: A social event is a gathering of people for the purpose of socializing, entertainment, or celebration.

words.ex: We took a different route to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们换了条路线以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A route is a way from one place to another, or the path that something follows to reach a destination.

words.ex: He bought a brand new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆全新的自行车。
words.en: Completely new, not used or owned by anyone else before.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术中心；文化艺术中心
words.ex: The new arts centre will host a variety of cultural events.
words.ex_cn: 新的艺术中心将举办各种文化活动。
words.en: A place where various forms of art are exhibited, performed, or taught.

words.tr: adj. 较合意的；更可取的；
words.ex: Tea is preferable to coffee in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上喝茶比喝咖啡更合意。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

words.ex: The bread has many fibres.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包含有许多纤维。
words.en: Fibres are thin, thread-like structures that are found in plants and animals, used in the manufacture of textiles and other materials.

words.tr: unk. 做模特儿； vt. & vi. 做模特儿（model的过去式与过去分词形式）；
words.ex: She was modelled for a fashion magazine last week.
words.ex_cn: 她上周为一本时尚杂志当模特。
words.en: To model means to create a representation or simulation of something, often for the purpose of study or imitation. It can also refer to the act of shaping or forming something, such as clay or a career, based on a particular pattern or example.

words.ex: He wants to stand for election next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年参选。
words.en: To be a candidate in an election.

words.ex: The administrator fixed the computer system.
words.ex_cn: 管理人员修复了计算机系统。
words.en: An administrator is a person whose job involves helping to organize and supervise the way that an organization or institution functions.

words.ex: They decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定把会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone something means to arrange for it to take place at a later time than was originally planned.

words.tr: n. (车辆等座位前)伸腿空间
words.ex: The airplane seat has little legroom.
words.ex_cn: 这个飞机座位的腿部空间很少。
words.en: Legroom is the amount of space in front of a seat in a vehicle or aircraft where a person can stretch their legs.

words.tr: phrase. 后台参观；后台导览
words.ex: We took backstage tours at the theater.
words.ex_cn: 我们在剧院参加了后台参观。
words.en: Guided visits that allow people to see the areas behind the scenes of a theater, concert venue, or other performance spaces, where the public does not usually have access.

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的时候；到时候；最终
words.ex: He will get the results in due course.
words.ex_cn: 他会在适当的时候收到结果。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or take place in due course, you mean that it will happen or take place at the appropriate time, not before.

words.tr: phrase. v. 出租；把……租出去；受雇于他人提供服务
words.ex: They hire out bikes near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园附近出租自行车。
words.en: To allow someone to use something temporarily in exchange for money; to work for someone temporarily in exchange for money.

words.ex: The birds live in a nature reserve.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在自然保护区。
words.en: A nature reserve is a protected area of importance for wildlife, flora, fauna or features of geological or other special interest, which is reserved and managed for conservation and to provide special opportunities for study or research.

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

words.ex: There are many varieties of apples in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的苹果。
words.en: Varieties refers to the quality or state of being different or diverse; the absence of uniformity, sameness, or monotony.

words.ex: The lifeguard saved a boy from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 救生员救了一个差点溺水的男孩。
words.en: A lifeguard is a person who is responsible for the safety of people at a beach or swimming pool, and who rescues those who are in danger of drowning.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: Pedestrians walk on the sidewalk safely.
words.ex_cn: 步行者在人行道上安全行走。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking, especially in a town or city, rather than travelling in a vehicle.

words.ex: The city has built new cycle paths to encourage more people to ride bikes.
words.ex_cn: n. 城市修建了新的自行车道，以鼓励更多人骑自行车。
words.en: Paths or routes designated for the use of bicycles, often separated from motor vehicle traffic.

words.tr:
n. 旁路；
v. 绕过；
words.ex: The city built a bypass around the old town.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建了一条绕过老城区的旁路。
words.en: If you bypass a place or a system, you avoid it or go around it instead of going through it.

words.tr: phrase. 独立商店；非连锁经营的零售店
words.ex: Independent stores sell local handmade goods.
words.ex_cn: 独立小店出售本地手工制品。
words.en: Retail businesses not affiliated with large chains.

words.ex: She shops at chain stores because they are cheap.
words.ex_cn: 她去连锁店购物，因为它们很便宜。
words.en: A chain store is a retail outlet that is part of a larger company that operates multiple stores. These stores share a brand and central management, and usually have standardized business methods and practices.

words.tr: n. 摧毁；拆毁；拆除；大败；
words.ex: The demolition of the old building started last week.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧楼的拆除上周开始了。
words.en: The act of demolishing something, especially a building.

words.tr: v. 重新装饰；翻新装修；“redecorate”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: They redecorated their living room last week.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周重新装修了客厅。
words.en: To decorate something again or differently.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: Archaeologists dig old bones and pots.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家挖掘古老的骨头和陶器。
words.en: Archaeologists are scientists who study human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts and other physical remains.

words.ex: The museum displays ancient artefacts from Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了来自埃及的古代人工制品。
words.en: An artefact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: He has arthritis in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他双手有关节炎。
words.en: Arthritis is a medical condition in which the joints in someone's body are swollen and painful.

words.tr: n. 围裙( apron的名词复数 ); 停机坪，台口（舞台幕前的部份）
words.ex: The women wear white aprons while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 这些妇女在做饭时穿着白色围裙。
words.en: An apron is a piece of clothing that you wear over the front of your normal clothes and tie round your waist, especially when you are cooking, in order to prevent your clothes from getting dirty.

words.ex: The potter fired the clay in a kiln.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把陶土放在窑里烧制。
words.en: A kiln is a type of oven that is used to bake clay and pottery in order to make them hard.

words.ex: The artist fires the pottery in a kiln at high temperature.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家将陶器在窑中高温烧制。

words.tr: phrase. 有毒化合物；毒性化合物
words.ex: The water has toxic compounds from factories.
words.ex_cn: 水中含有工厂排放的有毒化合物。
words.en: Harmful or poisonous chemical substances.

words.ex: The artist shaped the clay on the potter's wheel.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家在波特之轮上塑造泥土。
words.en: A rotating circular device used by a potter to shape clay.

words.tr: vt. 彻底改变（revolutionise 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The smartphone revolutionised how people communicate.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机彻底改变了人们的沟通方式。
words.en: To completely change something so that it is much better.

words.ex: He uses a sculpting tool to shape clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用雕刻工具塑造黏土。
words.en: A tool used for shaping or carving materials.

words.tr: n. 鲑鱼；三文鱼；大马哈鱼；
words.ex: He grilled salmon for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他烤了鲑鱼当晚餐。
words.en: A salmon is a large silver-coloured fish which lives in the sea and rivers.

words.ex: He is allergic to shellfish.
words.ex_cn: 他对贝类过敏。
words.en: Shellfish are sea creatures that live in shells and are eaten as food.

words.ex: We ate grilled prawns for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们晚餐吃了烤大虾。
words.en: Prawns are large shrimp that are often used in cooking.

words.ex: She picked samphire from the rocky coast.
words.ex_cn: 她从岩石海岸采摘了海蓬子。
words.en: A fleshy-leaved plant that grows near the sea, often used in cooking for its salty flavor.

words.tr: phrase. 一把；少量；难对付的人或事（尤指令人头疼但可爱的人）
words.ex: She gave me a handful of candies.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一把糖果。
words.en: A handful refers to a small quantity that can be held in one hand, or a person or thing that is difficult to manage.

words.ex: The apple is ripe and ready to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果熟了，可以吃了。
words.en: When fruit or crops are ripe, they are ready to be eaten or harvested because they have developed to the right stage.

words.ex: He ate a sweet melon for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块甜瓜当甜点。
words.en: A melon is a large, juicy fruit with a hard rind, belonging to the gourd family, typically eaten fresh.

words.ex: She adds spices to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她给汤里加香料。
words.en: Spices are substances obtained from plants, which are used to flavor food or drink.

words.ex: He ate a coconut for snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一个椰子当零食。
words.en: A coconut is the large brown seed of a tropical tree, which has a hard shell containing white flesh that you can eat and a clear liquid that you can drink.

words.tr: adj. 自制的；家庭制作的
words.ex: She ate a home-made cake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一块自制的蛋糕。
words.en: Made or prepared at home, rather than in a shop or factory.

words.ex: She baked apple tarts for the family picnic.
words.ex_cn: 她为家庭野餐烤了苹果果馅饼。
words.en: A tart is a baked dish consisting of a filling over a pastry base with an open top not covered with pastry. The pastry is usually shortcrust pastry; the filling may be sweet or savory, though modern tarts are usually fruit-based, sometimes with custard.

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.ex: Immigration to this country has increased recently.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的移民数量最近增加了。
words.en: Immigration is the act of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own.

words.ex: He faces many challenges every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天面临许多挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: He cannot talk to the doctor because of the language barrier.
words.ex_cn: 由于语言障碍，他无法和医生交流。
words.en: A language barrier is a figurative phrase used primarily to refer to linguistic barriers to communication, i.e., the difficulties in communication experienced by people or groups originally speaking different languages, or even dialects in some cases.

words.ex: The movie was hilarious and made us laugh a lot.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影非常搞笑，让我们笑得很开心。
words.en: If you describe something as hilarious, you mean that it is extremely funny and it makes you laugh a lot.

words.tr: phrase. 简笔画；火柴人图画（用简单的线条表示人物或物体的图画）
words.ex: He made stick drawings of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他画了家人的人形简笔画。
words.en: Simple line drawings that represent objects or figures.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: Phone notifications are common distractions while studying.
words.ex_cn: 手机通知是学习时常见的分心因素。
words.en: Something that prevents someone from concentrating on something else.

words.ex: He solved the math problem independently.
words.ex_cn: 他独立地解决了这道数学题。
words.en: In a way that is free from outside control; not depending on another's authority.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.ex: I prefer listening to audio books while commuting.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在通勤时听有声书。
words.en: Audio books are recordings of books being read aloud, allowing people to listen to the content instead of reading it.

words.tr: phrase. 把……记在脑子里；心里记住
words.ex: I make a mental note to call her tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我记下要明天给她打电话。
words.en: To remember something without writing it down, committing it to memory for future reference.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.tr: n. 图书馆馆长；图书馆管理员；图书馆馆长，图书馆管理员( librarian的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The librarians helped students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆馆长帮助学生找到书籍。
words.en: People who work in libraries, managing books and assisting readers.

words.ex: The transformation of the old factory into a park made the city nicer.
words.ex_cn: 把旧工厂改造成公园让城市变得更美了。
words.en: A transformation is a complete change in the appearance, form, or nature of something or someone.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr: 荒地; 闲田; 闲地
words.ex: The old factory turned the waste land into a park.
words.ex_cn: 那家旧工厂把荒地改造成了一座公园。
words.en: A waste land is an area of land that is not used, cultivated, or built on, often because it is considered unsuitable for these purposes.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.ex: The troop marched into the town at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 部队在黎明时分进入城镇。
words.en: A troop is a group of soldiers or a large group of people or animals.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.tr: phrase. 草拟；停住；逼近；追上；整队
words.ex: He will draw up a plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会起草一个计划。
words.en: To prepare and write something such as a document or plan, or to bring a vehicle to a stop.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: The train arrived on schedule.
words.ex_cn: 火车准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on schedule, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.tr: v. 自动提供；自愿效劳；自动提供，自愿效劳( volunteer的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is volunteering to help clean the park.
words.ex_cn: 他主动提供帮助清理公园。
words.en: Volunteering is the act of offering to do something without being forced to do it, especially offering to do something that involves helping other people.

words.ex: The child has behavioural difficulties in school.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在学校有行为问题。
words.en: Behavioural difficulties refer to problems in how a person acts or conducts themselves, often requiring intervention or support.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with dementia last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有痴呆。
words.en: Dementia is a condition characterized by progressive or persistent loss of intellectual functioning, especially memory impairment, often associated with aging.

words.ex: He has high self-esteem after passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他自尊心很强。
words.en: Self-esteem is the opinion you have of yourself and your abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 学习障碍；学习困难（指在阅读、写作、计算等方面存在的持续性困难）
words.ex: He has learning difficulties in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上有学习困难。
words.en: Learning difficulties refer to problems that affect the brain's ability to receive, process, analyze, or store information, making it hard for a person to learn as quickly as someone who isn't affected by these difficulties.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.tr:
adj. 稳定的；
v. 使稳住；
words.ex: The boat moved in a steady way on the calm sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在平静的海面上平稳地移动。
words.en: If something is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about. If you steady something, you stop it from shaking or moving about.

words.tr: phrase. 显著的增长；可察觉的增长
words.ex: There has been a noticeable growth in the number of students attending the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 参加讲座的学生人数有了显著增长。
words.en: A significant increase in size, amount, or degree that can be easily seen or noticed.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险度假；以探险活动为主的假期
words.ex: We went on adventure holidays in New Zealand last summer.
words.ex_cn: n. 去年夏天我们去了新西兰的冒险假期。
words.en: Adventure holidays refer to vacations that involve exciting or risky activities, often in exotic or wilderness locations.

words.tr: phrase. 高风险活动；指可能带来严重伤害或重大损失的活动
words.ex: Engaging in high-risk activities without proper safety measures can lead to serious injuries.
words.ex_cn: 参与高风险活动而不采取适当的安全措施可能导致严重伤害。
words.en: Activities that involve a high level of risk or danger, often requiring special precautions to prevent accidents or injuries.

words.tr: phrase. 志趣相投的人；想法相似的人
words.ex: They found it easy to collaborate with like-minded people.
words.ex_cn: 他们发现与志同道合的人合作很容易。
words.en: People who share similar opinions, interests, or attitudes.

words.ex: She cooks with organic ingredients.
words.ex_cn: 她用有机食材做饭。
words.en: Food or substances derived from living organisms, grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers, emphasizing natural production methods.

words.tr: 短语. 已知条件；理所当然的事
words.ex: He solved the problem with a given number.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个给定的数字解决了这个问题。
words.en: A fact or situation that is accepted as true or existing without needing proof.

words.tr: phrase. 一对一辅导；个别授课；私人教学
words.ex: He gets one-on-one tuition in math every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都接受一对一的数学辅导。
words.en: One-on-one tuition refers to a method of teaching where a single student is taught by a single teacher, allowing for personalized instruction and attention.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: He had a consultation with the doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他与医生进行了一次咨询。
words.en: A consultation is a meeting which is held to discuss something. Consultation is discussion about something that is still being planned.

words.tr: phrase. 量身定制的；专为……设计的
words.ex: The curriculum is tailored to the needs of each student.
words.ex_cn: 课程根据每个学生的需求量身定制。
words.en: Made or adapted for a particular purpose or individual.

words.ex: He is keen on playing football after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后非常喜欢踢足球。
words.en: To have a strong interest in or enthusiasm for something.

words.ex: He enjoys long-distance cycling on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末进行长距离骑行。

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: The store runs from 8 a.m. until 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 这家店从早上8点营业到晚上8点。

words.tr: phrase. 试行地；作为试验；在试用基础上
words.ex: He is working on a trial basis for one month.
words.ex_cn: 他正在以试用的方式工作一个月。
words.en: If something is done on a trial basis, it is done experimentally to see if it will be successful or effective.

words.tr: phrase. v. 尝试做某事；向某人挑战；批评或攻击某人
words.ex: He wants to have a go at riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想试着骑一下自行车。
words.en: To attempt or try to do something.

words.ex: I wasn't too happy with the service at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我对餐厅的服务不太满意。

words.tr: phrase. 就……而言；关于……；就……来说
words.ex: As far as I am concerned, the meeting can be canceled.
words.ex_cn: 就我而言，会议可以取消。
words.en: used to indicate the speaker's opinion or the aspect being considered

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 我推测；我认为；想必（用于表达基于合理推断的结论）
words.ex: I presume he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜他明天会来。
words.en: I suppose something is true based on probability.

words.ex: He thought she was angry, but rather the opposite in fact, she was happy.
words.ex_cn: 他以为她生气了，但事实上恰恰相反，她很高兴。
words.en: Used to emphasize that the opposite of what was previously stated is true.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.ex: Let me explain how to solve this problem.
words.ex_cn: 让我解释一下如何解决这个问题。
words.en: A phrase used to introduce a clarification or detailed explanation.

words.tr: 名词短语。客户满意度调查，指企业为了解顾客对其产品或服务的满意程度而进行的问卷调查或评估活动
words.ex: The store sent a customer satisfaction survey to all buyers.
words.ex_cn: 商店向所有顾客发送了一份顾客满意度调查。
words.en: A customer satisfaction survey is a tool used by businesses to gauge how satisfied their customers are with their products or services.

words.tr: phrase. 一日游；当天往返的短途旅行
words.ex: We went on a day trip to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们去海边进行了一日游。
words.en: A short trip or excursion lasting one day, usually for leisure or sightseeing.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.ex: He has a day off on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他星期五休息一天。
words.en: A day off is a day when you do not go to work or school, especially because you have a holiday or because you need or want to rest.

words.tr: phrase. 季票；（在一定期限内可多次使用的）通票
words.ex: He buys a season ticket for the football matches.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了足球比赛的季票。
words.en: A season ticket is a ticket that allows the holder to attend a specified number of events, such as sports games or concerts, within a certain period, usually a season, for a single price.

words.ex: He bought a return ticket to London.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张去伦敦的往返票。
words.en: A return ticket is a ticket for a journey to a place and back again.

words.tr: phrase. 火车优惠卡；铁路乘车卡（用于购买折扣火车票的证件）
words.ex: He uses a rail card to save money on train tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他使用铁路卡节省火车票费用。
words.en: A rail card is a card that allows the holder to get discounts on train tickets.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.tr: phrase. 性价比高的；物有所值的
words.ex: This phone is good value for money.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机物有所值。
words.en: If something is good value for money, it is worth the amount of money that you pay for it.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 提前计划；预先筹划
words.ex: He plans ahead for his exams.
words.ex_cn: 他提前为考试做计划。
words.en: To think about and decide what you are going to do or how you are going to do something before you do it.

words.ex: He bought a train ticket at the ticket office.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处买了一张火车票。
words.en: A ticket office is a place where tickets are sold to the public for admission to a theater, for travel on public transportation, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 售票机；自动售票机（复数）
words.ex: There are ticket machines at every subway station.
words.ex_cn: 每个地铁站都有售票机。
words.en: A ticket machine is a vending machine that produces tickets. For instance, ticket machines dispense train tickets at a railway station, transit tickets at a metro station, or tickets for admission to a cinema or other entertainment venue.

words.tr: phrase. 出故障的；次序颠倒的；不合规定的；不适的
words.ex: The elevator is out of order.
words.ex_cn: 电梯坏了。
words.en: If something is out of order, it is not working properly.

words.ex: He bought an e-ticket for the flight.
words.ex_cn: 他为航班购买了一张电子票。
words.en: An e-ticket is a digital ticket used for events, travel, or other activities, which can be stored on a mobile device or printed out.

words.ex: The hotel offers free wifi for guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为客人提供免费无线网络。
words.en: A technology that allows electronic devices to connect to a wireless local area network (WLAN).

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.tr: phrase. 落后于计划；误点；拖延的
words.ex: The train is behind schedule.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: If someone or something is behind schedule, they are not progressing as quickly as planned or expected.

words.tr: v. 提升； adj. 升级的；升级的，提升的 v. 提升( upgrade的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better speed.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更快的速度。
words.en: To upgrade something means to improve it by adding or replacing parts, or to make it of a higher standard.

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人泄气的；让人懊恼的； v. “frustrate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The slow internet is frustrating.
words.ex_cn: 网速慢让人沮丧。
words.en: If something is frustrating, it annoys you or makes you angry because you cannot do anything about the problems it causes.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 平台；站台；月台；“platform”的复数；
words.ex: The company uses online platforms to sell products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用在线平台销售产品。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure or area, often used for public speaking, performances, or as a base for machinery or equipment.

words.tr: n. 座位安排；供给座位； v. “seat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The theater improved its seating for better comfort.
words.ex_cn: 剧院改进了座位安排以提升舒适度。
words.en: The arrangement of seats in a place, or the provision of seats for people to sit on.

words.ex: After trying the new restaurant, I was neither satisfied nor dissatisfied with the meal.
words.ex_cn: 尝试了这家新餐厅后，我对这顿饭既不满意也不不满意。
words.en: feeling or showing neither satisfaction nor dissatisfaction

words.ex: He completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了木工学徒期。
words.en: An apprenticeship is a period of time in which someone learns a trade or profession by working under the supervision of a skilled worker.

words.tr: adj. 有挑战性的； v. 提出挑战；“challenge”的现在分词；
words.ex: The math problem was challenging.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很有挑战性。
words.en: If you describe something as challenging, you mean that it tests your ability and determination and that you need to work hard to deal with it or achieve it.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.ex: The teacher is very approachable and always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师非常和蔼可亲，总是面带微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as approachable, you think that they are friendly and easy to talk to.

words.ex: He makes the most of his time to study.
words.ex_cn: 他充分利用时间学习。
words.en: To use something to its fullest potential or to take full advantage of an opportunity.

words.tr: v. 分配；指派；“assign”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 指定的；
words.ex: The teacher assigned homework to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们布置了作业。
words.en: Given a specific task, role, or responsibility.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.tr: phrase. 每周一次地；按周地
words.ex: He exercises on a weekly basis.
words.ex_cn: 他每周锻炼一次。
words.en: If something happens on a weekly basis, it happens once a week or every week.

words.ex: He sets new goals every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都设定新的目标。
words.en: An aim or desired result that a person or a group of people works towards achieving.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.tr: phrase. 长期抱负；长远雄心
words.ex: He has long-term ambitions to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他有成为医生的长期抱负。
words.en: Long-term ambitions refer to goals or aspirations that one aims to achieve over a considerable period of time, often requiring sustained effort and planning.

words.ex: He is on probationary status at his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他在新工作中处于试用期。
words.en: Relating to a period of testing or trial, especially for a new employee or a criminal on parole.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.tr: v. 允许；允许( permit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The teacher permitted us to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 老师允许我们早点离开。
words.en: Allowed or authorized, especially by an authority.

words.tr: adj. 法定的；依照法规的；
words.ex: The statutory minimum wage is $10 per hour.
words.ex_cn: 法定最低工资是每小时10美元。
words.en: Statutory means relating to rules or laws which have been formally written down.

words.ex: He feels unwell after eating too much ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多冰淇淋后感觉不舒服。
words.en: If you are unwell, you are ill.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.ex: He has many family commitments on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末有很多家庭事务要处理。
words.en: A commitment is a promise or firm decision to do something, or the fact of promising to do something.

words.ex: The school has a strict dress code.
words.ex_cn: 学校有严格的着装规定。
words.en: A set of rules specifying the attire that is appropriate for a particular place or event.

words.ex: He wears casual clothes to the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末穿便服去公园。
words.en: Clothes designed for informal occasions, emphasizing comfort and ease of wear.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.ex: She walks in high heels to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着高跟鞋去参加派对。
words.en: High heels are women's shoes with high, narrow heels.

words.ex: The company follows health and safety rules.
words.ex_cn: 公司遵守健康与安全规定。
words.en: Principles and procedures designed to protect the safety and well-being of people in a workplace or environment.

words.tr: n. 教练员；运动鞋；训练者；驯兽师；“trainer”的复数；
words.ex: The trainers helped the players improve their skills.
words.ex_cn: 教练员帮助球员提高他们的技能。
words.en: Trainers are shoes worn for sports or casual occasions. They are designed to be comfortable and supportive for physical activities.

words.ex: The bus tickets are heavily subsidised by the government.
words.ex_cn: 公交车票由政府大力补贴。
words.en: Given financial support in a large amount by the government or an organization.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.tr: adj. 不卫生的，不干净的；
words.ex: The kitchen was unhygienic and full of dirt.
words.ex_cn: 厨房很不卫生，到处都是脏东西。
words.en: If you describe something as unhygienic, you mean that it is dirty and likely to cause illness or disease.

words.tr: v. 自动提供；自愿效劳；自动提供，自愿效劳( volunteer的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is volunteering to help clean the park.
words.ex_cn: 他主动提供帮助清理公园。
words.en: Volunteering is the act of offering to do something without being forced to do it, especially offering to do something that involves helping other people.

words.ex: The school supports many charity projects for poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校支持许多为贫困儿童提供的慈善项目。

words.tr: phrase. 时间投入；时间承诺；指为某项任务或活动所承诺或必须花费的时间
words.ex: She made a big time commitment to learn piano.
words.ex_cn: 她为学习钢琴投入了大量时间。
words.en: The amount of time that one is required or expected to devote to a particular activity or cause.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭责任；家庭义务
words.ex: He missed the party because of family commitments.
words.ex_cn: 他因为家庭责任错过了聚会。
words.en: Obligations or responsibilities related to one's family that require time, effort, or resources.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: adj. 有动机的；有积极性的； v. 激发；“motivate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is motivated to study hard for the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他有动力努力为考试学习。
words.en: If you are motivated by something, especially a strong emotion, it causes you to behave in a particular way.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.tr: phrase. 保护项目； conservation 指对自然资源、环境或文化遗产的保护，project 指计划或工程，合起来指旨在保护自然或文化资源的计划或工程
words.ex: The conservation project aims to protect endangered species in the area.
words.ex_cn: 这个保护项目旨在保护该地区的濒危物种。
words.en: A conservation project is a planned endeavor aimed at preserving natural resources, wildlife, or historical sites.

words.tr: phrase. 培训设施；训练场所
words.ex: The team uses the training facility every morning.
words.ex_cn: 球队每天早上使用训练设施。
words.en: A training facility is a place equipped with resources and equipment for the purpose of training individuals in various skills or sports.

words.tr: phrase. 信息与通信技术专用教室；计算机综合教室
words.ex: The company invested in a new ICT suite to improve productivity.
words.ex_cn: 公司投资了一套新的信息技术套件以提高生产力。
words.en: A set of software tools and applications designed to support information and communication technology tasks.

words.tr: phrase. 与…配对；与…搭配；与…组合
words.ex: The socks are paired with the shoes.
words.ex_cn: 袜子和鞋子配对。
words.en: To match or combine someone or something with someone or something else.

words.ex: He gave a dismissive shrug when she explained her idea.
words.ex_cn: 当她解释自己的想法时，他轻蔑地耸了耸肩。
words.en: If you are dismissive of someone or something, you show that you do not consider them to be important or worth considering.

words.ex: We should keep in touch even after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我们毕业后也应该保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone, especially after not seeing them for a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. v. 派上用场；变得有用
words.ex: This tool will come in handy when you fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 当你修自行车时，这个工具会派上用场。
words.en: If an object or skill comes in handy, it is useful in a particular situation.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上读书。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: The subcommittee met to discuss the budget.
words.ex_cn: 小组委员会开会讨论预算。
words.en: A subcommittee is a smaller committee formed from a main committee to concentrate on a specific task or area.

words.tr: phrase. 使你了解最新情况；向你通报最新进展
words.ex: Let me bring you up to date on the latest developments.
words.ex_cn: 让我给你介绍一下最新的进展情况。
words.en: To inform someone about the latest information or developments.

words.ex: The store offers an assortment of snacks.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供各种各样的零食。
words.en: An assortment is a group of similar things that are of different types or sizes.

words.tr: phrase. 在偏僻处；不碍事；罕见
words.ex: The old shed is out of the way, behind the hill.
words.ex_cn: 那个旧棚子在山后面，很偏僻。
words.en: If something is out of the way, it is not blocking a path or is in a remote or isolated location.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险游乐场（一种鼓励儿童自由探索和创造性游戏的开放式游乐场所）
words.ex: The children play on the adventure playground after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在冒险游乐场玩耍。
words.en: An adventure playground is a type of playground designed to encourage children's exploration and adventure, often featuring structures for climbing, building, and imaginative play.

words.tr: phrase. 规整式花园；布局对称、设计严谨的园林，通常包含修剪整齐的灌木、几何形花坛和路径
words.ex: The palace has formal gardens with neat paths and trimmed hedges.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿有整齐的小路和修剪过的树篱的正式花园。
words.en: Formal gardens are gardens that are designed in a precise, geometric pattern, often with symmetrical layouts and carefully trimmed plants.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.tr: phrase. 户外健身房；露天健身场所
words.ex: He exercises at the outdoor gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在户外健身房锻炼。
words.en: Exercise equipment installed in a public park or open space for public use.

words.tr: phrase. 玻璃房子（常用于习语 'people who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones'，意为‘住在玻璃房子里的人不应向别人扔石头’，比喻自身有缺点的人不应批评他人）
words.ex: He criticized his friend for being late, but he should remember that people who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.
words.ex_cn: 他批评朋友迟到，但他应该记住，住在玻璃房子里的人不应向别人扔石头。
words.en: A phrase used to suggest that people should not criticize others for faults that they themselves possess.

words.tr: phrase. 滑板坡道；专为滑板运动设计的斜坡设施
words.ex: He practices tricks on the skateboard ramp.
words.ex_cn: 他在滑板坡道上练习特技。
words.en: A skateboard ramp is a structure used in skateboarding, which provides a slope for skateboarders to perform tricks.

words.ex: She picks wild flowers in the meadow.
words.ex_cn: 她在草地上摘野花。
words.en: Wild flowers are flowers that grow naturally in the wild, not planted by humans.

words.tr: phrase. 发泄情绪；宣泄精力；释放压力
words.ex: He runs every day to let off steam.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步来发泄情绪。
words.en: If you let off steam, you get rid of your energy, anger, or strong emotions by doing something active or noisy.

words.tr: phrase. 可用的资金；可动用的资金
words.ex: The company has limited available funds for new projects.
words.ex_cn: 公司对新项目的可动用资金有限。
words.en: Funds that are accessible and can be used for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 全年的；一年到头的
words.ex: He works year-round at the ice cream shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在冰淇淋店全年工作。
words.en: Something that is year-round exists, happens, or is done throughout the year.

words.ex: We will proceed irrespective of the cost.
words.ex_cn: 我们将继续进行，无论成本如何。
words.en: without considering; regardless of

words.ex: Please keep an eye on the baby while I cook.
words.ex_cn: 我做饭时，请照看一下宝宝。
words.en: To watch or look after someone or something carefully.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.tr: phrase. 热带棕榈树（指生长在热带地区的棕榈科树木）
words.ex: The beach was lined with tropical palm trees, providing shade and a sense of tranquility.
words.ex_cn: 海滩上排列着热带棕榈树，为人们提供了阴凉和宁静的感觉。
words.en: Palm trees that grow naturally in hot, humid regions near the equator, characterized by tall, slender trunks and large, fan-like or feather-like leaves.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；“contribute”的现在分词； adj. 起作用的；
words.ex: He is contributing money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为慈善机构捐款。
words.en: Playing a part in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.tr: phrase. 遗产农场；具有历史价值的传统农场
words.ex: The family runs a heritage farm to preserve old farming methods.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭经营着一座遗产农场，以保存传统的农耕方法。
words.en: A farm that preserves traditional methods, buildings, or practices of historical significance.

words.tr: phrase. 乡村生活；田园生活
words.ex: Many people dream of escaping to rural life for peace and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 许多人梦想逃离到乡村生活，寻求宁静。
words.en: The lifestyle and activities associated with living in the countryside, often characterized by agriculture, simplicity, and close community ties.

words.ex: The loud noise frightened the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something or someone frightens you, they cause you to suddenly feel afraid, anxious, or nervous.

words.tr: phrase. 稀有品种；罕见种类（尤指动物或植物）
words.ex: The farm protects rare breeds of sheep.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场保护稀有品种的羊。
words.en: Rare breeds: Uncommon or endangered varieties of animals, particularly livestock, that are preserved for genetic or cultural reasons.

words.tr: adj. 不平坦的；不均匀的；
words.ex: The road is uneven and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路不平坦，很难开车。
words.en: Something that is uneven is not regular, consistent, or equal.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.tr: phrase. 导盲犬（为视障人士提供引导和帮助的受过训练的狗）
words.ex: Guide dogs help blind people walk safely.
words.ex_cn: 导盲犬帮助盲人安全行走。
words.en: A guide dog is a dog that has been specially trained to help blind people by guiding them around obstacles and indicating when it is safe to cross a road.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: The scarecrow stands in the field to keep birds away.
words.ex_cn: 稻草人站在田里赶走鸟儿。
words.en: A scarecrow is an object in the shape of a person, which is put in a field where crops are growing in order to frighten birds away.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的曲径；
words.ex: The children got lost in the maze.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A maze is a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost.

words.tr: n. 灌木篱笆；（复数）对冲；
words.ex: The garden is surrounded by tall hedges.
words.ex_cn: 花园被高高的灌木篱笆围住。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees, usually along the edge of a garden, field, or road. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid giving a direct answer or to protect oneself against financial loss.

words.tr: phrase. 技能工作坊；旨在提升特定技能的实践性培训课程或研讨会
words.ex: The company offers skills workshops to improve employee productivity.
words.ex_cn: 公司提供技能研讨会以提高员工的工作效率。
words.en: Skills workshops are sessions or courses designed to teach or improve specific abilities or techniques.

words.tr: phrase. 传统手工艺；传统工艺制品
words.ex: She makes traditional crafts with her grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 她和祖母一起制作传统手工艺品。
words.en: Traditional crafts refer to the skills and methods of making objects by hand that have been passed down through generations, often reflecting the cultural heritage of a particular community or region.

words.ex: He spends weekends doing woodwork in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他周末在车库里做木工活。
words.en: The activity or skill of making things from wood.

words.tr: n. 编篮子的工艺；编篮子的行为
words.ex: He is learning basket-making from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向祖父学习编篮子。
words.en: Basket-making is the craft of creating containers by weaving materials like reeds or cane.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.ex: The chickens live in the farmyard.
words.ex_cn: 鸡住在农舍院子里。
words.en: A farmyard is the area of land around a farmhouse, where the farm buildings are, and where animals are kept.

words.ex: Children walk on the footpath to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在人行道上步行去学校。
words.en: A footpath is a path that is designed for people to walk along, especially one in the countryside or a park.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.tr: phrase. 建筑特征；建筑特色
words.ex: The building has many architectural features from the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 这栋建筑有许多来自19世纪的建筑特色。
words.en: Distinctive structural or design elements of a building, such as arches, columns, or decorative details, that define its character.

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: Please leave your coat in the cloakroom.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的外套放在衣帽间。
words.en: A cloakroom is a room where coats, hats, luggage, or other items may be left temporarily, as in a theater, public building, or school.

words.ex: My son loves watching cartoon animation.
words.ex_cn: 我儿子喜欢看卡通动画。
words.en: Animation is the process of making films in which drawings or puppets appear to move.

words.tr: adj. 自明的；不需加以说明的
words.ex: The instructions are self-explanatory.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明一目了然。
words.en: Something that is self-explanatory is clear and easy to understand without needing any further explanation.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.tr: n. 着陆；降落；楼梯平台； v. “land”的现在分词；
words.ex: The plane made a smooth landing at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场平稳着陆。
words.en: The act of coming to or bringing something to land, especially an aircraft.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: The city is redeveloping the old factory area.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在重新开发旧工厂区域。
words.en: To redevelop means to develop again or differently, especially to improve an area by replacing old buildings with new ones or changing the use of land.

words.ex: The museum exhibits ancient artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展示古代文物。
words.en: To show something publicly, especially in an art gallery or museum, or to show a particular quality or ability.

words.ex: He collects old coins and keeps them in collections.
words.ex_cn: 他收集旧硬币并把它们保存成收藏品。
words.en: A group of objects or works to be seen, studied, or kept together.

words.tr: v. 捐赠； adj. v. 捐赠（donate 的过去分词形式）；
words.ex: She donated her old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 她把旧书捐给了图书馆。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization in order to help them.

words.tr: n. 改造（工程）；建筑改造；整修；
words.ex: The refurbishment of the old school took six months.
words.ex_cn: 这所旧学校的改造工程花了六个月。
words.en: The process of repairing and redecorating something, especially a building, to make it more attractive or functional.

words.ex: The museum has a temporary exhibition this month.
words.ex_cn: 这个月博物馆有一个临时展览。
words.en: A display of objects or artworks available to the public for a limited time.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: He bought a porcelain cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个瓷杯。
words.en: A hard, white, translucent ceramic that is made by firing a pure clay and then glazing it.

words.ex: He left his house to his daughter in terms of his will.
words.ex_cn: 根据他遗嘱的条款，他把房子留给了女儿。

words.ex: I will enquire about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 我会查询一下火车时刻表。
words.en: To ask for information about someone or something.

words.ex: I need to hire a room for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: v. 我需要为周末租用一个房间。
words.en: To rent a room for a specific period of time.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: The bottle is returnable if you bring it back.
words.ex_cn: 如果把瓶子退回来，是可以退还押金的。
words.en: Capable of being returned, especially for a refund or exchange.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 入场费；进入某地所需支付的费用
words.ex: The park has high entry charges for tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对游客收取很高的入场费。
words.en: Fees required for entering a place or event.

words.ex: He got a driving licence last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾驶执照。
words.en: A licence is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: The caretaker cleans the building every day.
words.ex_cn: 看管人每天打扫这座大楼。
words.en: A caretaker is a person whose job is to look after a large building such as a school or a block of flats or apartments, and deal with small repairs to it.

words.tr: phrase. 禁止吸烟；请勿吸烟
words.ex: There is no smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate that smoking is not allowed in a certain area.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The actor waits at the stage door after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演员在演出后在侧门等候。
words.en: The entrance at the back of a theater used by performers and staff, often where fans wait to meet actors after a performance.

words.tr: phrase. 法律要求；法定要求；法律规定
words.ex: The company must follow the legal requirement.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须遵守法律要求。
words.en: A legal requirement is a rule or obligation that is mandated by law.

words.tr: n. （企业或机构使用的）房屋及土地；“premise”的复数；
words.ex: The company owns its premises in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司拥有位于市中心的房产和土地。
words.en: The buildings and land that a business or organization uses.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.tr: phrase. 堆积起来；累积；（尤指比较时）与…相比
words.ex: The books were stacked up neatly on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地堆放在书架上。
words.en: To accumulate or pile up, often used to describe objects or situations where things are gathered or collected in large quantities.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.tr:
n. 通勤；
v. 通勤；
words.ex: His daily commute takes an hour by train.
words.ex_cn: 他每天的通勤坐火车要一个小时。
words.en: If you commute, you travel a long distance every day between your home and your place of work.

words.tr: n. 标准；尺度；准则；“criterion”的复数；
words.ex: The main criteria for selection are skill and experience.
words.ex_cn: 选择的主要标准是技能和经验。
words.en: A criterion is a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.tr: phrase. 陡坡；倾斜度很大的斜坡
words.ex: The hiker walked up a steep slope.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走上了一段陡峭的斜坡。
words.en: A rapid incline or gradient, especially one that is difficult to climb.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 融入；与……协调一致
words.ex: He tries to blend in with the group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入这个群体。
words.en: To mix or combine things together so that they cannot be easily separated, or to become part of something so that you are not noticed.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The sequence is bounded by 10 and -10.
words.ex_cn: 这个数列被限制在10和-10之间。
words.en: If an area of land is bounded by something, that thing is situated around its edge.

words.tr: phrase. 公寓楼；住宅大楼（指多户家庭居住的多层建筑）
words.ex: Many people live in apartment blocks in the city.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在城市里的公寓楼里居住。
words.en: A building containing several apartments, especially in a city.

words.tr: phrase. （道路、河流等）分岔，岔开；从主干分出
