words.en: An impoverished person or area is very poor.

words.ex: Fish live in healthy ecosystems.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在健康的生态系统中。
words.en: An ecosystem is a community of living organisms in conjunction with the nonliving components of their environment, interacting as a system.

words.ex: The jellyfish is an invertebrate.
words.ex_cn: 水母是一种无脊椎动物。
words.en: An invertebrate is an animal that does not have a backbone or spinal column.

words.ex: The tardigrade can survive in extreme environments.
words.ex_cn: 缓步类动物能在极端环境中生存。
words.en: A microscopic, eight-legged animal known for its ability to survive extreme conditions.

words.ex: The bacteria are microscopic.
words.ex_cn: 这些细菌极小。
words.en: So small as to be visible only with a microscope; of or relating to a microscope.

words.ex: The dog belongs to a phylum called chordata.
words.ex_cn: 狗属于一个叫做脊索动物门的门。
words.en: A major taxonomic group of organisms, ranking above a class and below a kingdom, and comprising organisms that share a common set of characteristics.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The cat used its claw to scratch the tree.
words.ex_cn: 猫用爪子抓树。
words.en: A claw is a curved pointed horny nail on each digit of the foot in birds, lizards, and some mammals. As a verb, it means to scratch, tear, or pull with claws or fingernails.

words.ex: The vacuum cleaner uses suction to pick up dust.
words.ex_cn: 吸尘器利用吸力来吸走灰尘。
words.en: Suction is the process by which liquids, gases, or small particles are drawn into a space or device because the pressure inside is lower than the pressure outside.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.ex: The dentist found a cavity in his tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医在他的牙齿上发现了一个腔。
words.en: A cavity is a hole or space inside something.

words.tr: adj. 压碎的；压扁的；压碎的，压扁的 v. 挤进( squash的过去式和过去分词 )； v. 将（某人[某物]）压扁；
words.ex: The tomatoes were squashed by the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 西红柿被重箱子压碎了。
words.en: To crush or squeeze something with force so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape.

words.tr: n. 短剑，匕首，探针; 通管针; 花柱; 通管丝
words.ex: The insect uses a stylet to suck plant juice.
words.ex_cn: 这种昆虫用口针吸食植物汁液。
words.en: A thin, pointed instrument used in medical or surgical procedures, especially for probing or inserting.

words.ex: The needle will pierce the skin.
words.ex_cn: 针会刺穿皮肤。
words.en: If a sharp object pierces something, or if you pierce something with a sharp object, the object goes into it and makes a hole in it.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

words.tr: n. 隐生现象；潜生现象；
words.ex: Some tardigrades enter cryptobiosis when the environment dries up.
words.ex_cn: 当环境变干时，某些缓步动物会进入隐生现象。
words.en: A state of suspended animation in organisms, allowing survival in extreme conditions by drastically reducing metabolic activity.

words.ex: The beer was stored in a large tun.
words.ex_cn: 啤酒被储存在一个大酒桶里。
words.en: A large cask, especially one for holding liquids such as beer or wine.

words.ex: He tried to retract his words after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵后试图收回他的话。
words.en: If you retract something that you have said or written, you say that you did not mean it.

words.ex: His metabolism is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的新陈代谢非常快。
words.en: Metabolism is the set of life-sustaining chemical transformations within the cells of living organisms.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.tr: abbr. 脱氧核糖核酸；“deoxyribonucleic acid”的缩写；
words.ex: DNA carries the genetic information in humans.
words.ex_cn: DNA携带人类的遗传信息。
words.en: DNA is a molecule that carries the genetic instructions used in the growth, development, functioning, and reproduction of all known living organisms and many viruses.

words.ex: The medicine helped revive the sick man.
words.ex_cn: 这剂药帮助这位病人恢复了生机。
words.en: To revive something means to bring it back to life, consciousness, or use, or to make it active or successful again.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: The fish swim among the seaweed near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在岸边的海藻间游动。
words.en: Seaweed is a plant that grows in the sea, especially in the ocean. It is often used in food, medicine, and cosmetics.

words.ex: The apple is coated with sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果裹了一层糖。
words.en: Covered with a layer of a particular substance.

words.ex: She applied hair gel to style her hair.
words.ex_cn: 她用了发胶来造型头发。
words.en: A gel is a thick, jelly-like substance, especially one used to style hair.

words.tr: phrase. 保护状况； conservation status 指物种或生态系统在自然界中的受威胁程度，常用于评估其是否濒危、易危或近危等状态
words.ex: The conservation status of the panda is endangered.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的保护状况是濒危。
words.en: The conservation status of a species is an indicator of the likelihood of that species continuing to survive either in the present day or the future. It takes into account factors such as the current number of individuals, trends in population increase or decrease, breeding success rates, known threats, and so on.

words.tr: phrase. 大规模灭绝；物种大灭绝
words.ex: Dinosaurs died in a mass extinction.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙在一次大规模灭绝中灭绝了。
words.en: A catastrophic event in Earth's history where a large percentage of species die out simultaneously, often due to environmental changes.

words.tr: adj. 濒临灭绝的；有灭绝危险的； v. “endanger”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The panda is an endangered animal.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是一种濒临灭绝的动物。
words.en: An animal or plant that is endangered is in danger of becoming extinct.

words.ex: People in the Neolithic age used stone tools.
words.ex_cn: 新石器时代的人们使用石器。
words.en: Relating to or denoting the later part of the Stone Age, when ground or polished stone weapons and implements prevailed.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The children walked carefully through the bog.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们小心地走过沼泽。
words.en: A bog is an area of wet muddy ground that is too soft to support a heavy body.

words.ex: The cave paintings predate written history.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画早于文字历史。
words.en: To exist or occur at a date earlier than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 碳定年法；碳-14测年法（一种通过测量有机物中碳-14的衰变来确定其年代的科学方法）
words.ex: Scientists use carbon dating to find the age of old bones.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用碳测年法来确定古老骨头的年代。
words.en: Carbon dating is a method for determining the age of an object containing organic material by using the properties of radiocarbon, a radioactive isotope of carbon.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr: adj. 饱和的； v. “saturate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sponge was saturated with water.
words.ex_cn: 海绵被水浸透了。
words.en: If something is saturated, it is completely soaked with liquid or has absorbed as much of a substance as it can.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.ex: The acidity of lemon juice is very high.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁的酸性很强。
words.en: Acidity is the level of acid in substances such as water, soil, or wine.

words.ex: His deficiency in math made him struggle in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的缺乏让他在课堂上很吃力。
words.en: A deficiency is a lack or shortage of something that is needed.

words.tr: n. 前任；前辈；原有事物
words.ex: He became the new manager, replacing his predecessor.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了新经理，接替了他的前任。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: The glass broke into small fragments.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃碎成了小碎片。
words.en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

words.tr: n. （牧马的）小围场；检阅场；设有围栏的一片土地；
words.ex: The horses graze in a small paddock near the barn.
words.ex_cn: 马儿在马厩附近的小围场里吃草。
words.en: A paddock is a small field or enclosure where horses are kept or exercised.

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.tr: phrase. 轮牧；轮流放牧（将牧场划分为若干小区，按顺序轮流放牧，使牧草得以恢复的一种可持续放牧管理方式）
words.ex: Farmers use rotational grazing to keep the grass healthy.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用轮牧来保持草的健康。
words.en: A method of managing pastureland by moving livestock between different fields to allow vegetation to recover.

words.tr: n. 过度放牧；过度啃食草场，导致土地退化和植被破坏
words.ex: The land is damaged because of over-grazing by too many sheep.
words.ex_cn: 由于羊太多导致过度放牧，土地受到了破坏。
words.en: The excessive grazing of land by livestock, leading to soil erosion and degradation.

words.ex: He felt sadness after the abandonment of his old dream.
words.ex_cn: 在放弃旧梦想后，他感到悲伤。
words.en: The act of giving up or leaving something or someone permanently.

words.ex: He took an intensive English course last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他参加了一个密集的英语课程。
words.en: Intensive is used to describe something that involves a lot of effort, energy, or attention in a short period of time.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.ex: The climatic changes affect the crops.
words.ex_cn: 气候的变化影响农作物。
words.en: Relating to the climate or weather conditions of a particular area.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: He won the award at the height of his career.
words.ex_cn: 他在职业生涯的巅峰时期赢得了这个奖项。

words.tr: phrase. 文学天才；才华横溢的作家
words.ex: She was hailed as a literary genius for her innovative approach to storytelling.
words.ex_cn: 她因在讲故事方面的创新方法而被誉为文学天才。
words.en: A person with exceptional creative ability in literature, capable of producing works of outstanding quality and originality.

words.tr: adj. 直言无讳的；坦率的；
words.ex: He is an outspoken teacher who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位直言不讳的老师，总是说真话。
words.en: Someone who is outspoken expresses their opinions frankly and honestly, even if they are likely to shock or offend people.

words.ex: The king was sent into exile after the revolution.
words.ex_cn: 革命后，国王被流放了。
words.en: Exile is the state of being sent away from one's home country or place of residence, often for political or punitive reasons.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；配备；供给；提供
words.ex: He will furnish the apartment with new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他将为公寓配备新家具。
words.en: To furnish a place means to put furniture and other things into it.

words.ex: The lock has an intricate design.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁有复杂的结构。
words.en: You use intricate to describe something that has many small parts or details.

words.tr: n. 雕刻品；雕刻图案； v. 雕刻；“carve”的现在分词；
words.ex: The museum displayed a beautiful wooden carving.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展示了一件精美的木雕品。
words.en: A carving is an object or design that has been cut out of a material such as wood or stone.

words.ex: The ceremony was solemn and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 仪式庄严而安静。
words.en: Solemn means very serious and not cheerful, often because something important or sad is happening or being remembered.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；和...形成对照
words.ex: He likes coffee, in contrast to his sister who likes tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，而他的妹妹喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: adj. 缺乏足够教育的；贫穷的； v. 剥夺；使丧失；“deprive”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Children from deprived areas often struggle to read and write.
words.ex_cn: 来自教育缺乏地区的儿童常常难以阅读和写作。
words.en: If you are deprived of something that you want or need, you do not have it.

words.ex: He donate money to the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他向贫困儿童捐赠钱。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization that needs help.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: Dopamine makes us feel happy when we succeed.
words.ex_cn: 当我们成功时，多巴胺让我们感到快乐。
words.en: A neurotransmitter in the brain that is involved in the regulation of movement, emotion, motivation, and pleasure.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 认知任务，指需要思维、记忆、注意力和问题解决等心理过程来完成的任务
words.ex: The study focuses on the impact of cognitive tasks on memory performance.
words.ex_cn: 该研究专注于认知任务对记忆表现的影响。
words.en: Tasks that involve the mental processes of perception, memory, judgment, and reasoning.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了治疗感冒的药。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.tr:
n. 青少年；
adj. 青少年的；
words.ex: The adolescent walked to school with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年和朋友们一起走路去上学。
words.en: An adolescent is a young person who is developing into an adult.

words.ex: The fence is a barrier to animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏是动物的障碍。
words.en: A barrier is something such as a rule, law, or policy that makes it difficult or impossible for something to happen or be achieved.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: The two companies worked together in collaboration.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司通过合作一起工作。
words.en: the act of working together with someone to produce or create something

words.ex: He felt isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤立。
words.en: The state of being in a place or situation that is separate from others

words.ex: He does an aerobic workout every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做有氧锻炼。
words.en: Physical exercises that are designed to improve the efficiency of the body's cardiovascular system in absorbing and transporting oxygen.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: Obesity is a serious health problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 肥胖是许多国家的一个严重健康问题。
words.en: Obesity is a medical condition in which excess body fat has accumulated to the extent that it may have a negative effect on health.

words.ex: He does high-intensity workouts every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行高强度锻炼。
words.en: High-intensity refers to something that is very strong, concentrated, or extreme in degree or power.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.ex: Bears go into hibernation in winter.
words.ex_cn: 熊在冬天冬眠。
words.en: Hibernation is a state of inactivity and metabolic depression in endotherms during winter.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.tr: n. 自然学家；博物学家；
words.ex: The naturalist studied birds in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位自然学家在森林里研究鸟类。
words.en: A naturalist is a person who studies or is an expert in natural history, especially a zoologist or botanist.

words.ex: The magic spell caused the transmutation of the frog into a prince.
words.ex_cn: 魔法咒语让青蛙变成了王子。
words.en: The act or process of changing something completely, especially into something different and better.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.tr: phrase. 业余科学家（指非专业、出于兴趣从事科学研究的人）
words.ex: He is an amateur scientist who loves doing experiments at home.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名业余科学家，喜欢在家做实验。
words.en: An enthusiast who studies science without formal training.

words.tr: phrase. 合乎逻辑的解释；合理的说明
words.ex: He gave a logical explanation for his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他对他答案给出了一个合乎逻辑的解释。
words.en: A rational and sensible reason for something.

words.tr: phrase. 决定性时刻；定义性的瞬间
words.ex: The election was a defining moment in the country's history.
words.ex_cn: 这次选举是国家历史上的一个决定性时刻。
words.en: A defining moment is a point in time or an event that significantly influences the course of one's life or the development of a situation.

words.ex: He loves ornithology and watches birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱鸟类学，每天早上都观察鸟类。
words.en: Ornithology is the branch of zoology that deals with the study of birds.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: The vast oceans cover most of the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 广阔的海洋覆盖了地球的大部分。
words.en: Extensive, expansive bodies of water covering most of the Earth's surface.

words.ex: He reported the harassment to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他向警察报告了骚扰行为。
words.en: Harassment is behaviour which is intended to trouble or annoy someone, especially repeated behaviour.

words.tr: phrase. 鸟类环志（在鸟类脚上套上带有编号的金属环，用于科学研究和追踪）
words.ex: Scientists are doing bird ringing to track migration.
words.ex_cn: 科学家正在进行鸟类环志以追踪迁徙。
words.en: The practice of attaching a small, lightweight ring to a bird's leg for identification and tracking purposes.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；难解的事件；错综复杂；
words.ex: The child got lost in the labyrinth.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A labyrinth is a complicated irregular network of passages or paths in which it is difficult to find one's way; a maze.

words.tr: adj. 蜿蜒的； v. “wind”的现在分词；
words.ex: The winding road goes through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条蜿蜒的道路穿过山脉。
words.en: A winding path, road, river, etc. repeatedly turns in different directions.

words.tr:
n. 螺旋形；陡升或骤降；
v. 螺旋式上升（或下降）；
adj. 螺旋形的；
words.ex: The snail moved along a spiral path.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛沿着一个螺旋形的路径爬行。
words.en: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round, with each curve above or outside the previous one.

words.tr: phrase. 蜿蜒曲折；迂回前进（常指道路、情节等复杂多变）
words.ex: The road twists and turns through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条路在山间蜿蜒曲折。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a winding or curving course.

words.ex: The synonym of 'happy' is 'glad'.
words.ex_cn: ‘happy’的同义词是‘glad’。
words.en: A synonym is a word or phrase that means exactly or nearly the same as another word or phrase in the same language.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的曲径；
words.ex: The children got lost in the maze.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A maze is a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: The lock has an intricate design.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁有复杂的结构。
words.en: You use intricate to describe something that has many small parts or details.

words.tr: phrase. 死胡同；没有出路的情况；无法继续发展的局面
words.ex: The road is a dead end.
words.ex_cn: 这条路是死胡同。
words.en: A dead end is a street or passage that is closed at one end, or a situation from which no progress can be made.

words.ex: Calling time a thief is a metaphor.
words.ex_cn: 把时间称为小偷是一种隐喻。
words.en: A metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.

words.ex: He finds peace through spiritual meditation.
words.ex_cn: 他通过精神上的冥想找到平静。
words.en: Relating to the human spirit or soul as opposed to material or physical things.

words.ex: He does meditation every morning to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以放松。
words.en: Meditation is the act of remaining in a silent and calm state for a period of time, as part of a religious training, or so that you are more able to deal with the problems of everyday life.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.ex: He loves studying cosmology to understand the universe.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢学习宇宙学来理解宇宙。
words.en: Cosmology is the study of the origin, structure, and evolution of the universe.

words.ex: The floor has a colorful mosaic of flowers.
words.ex_cn: 地板上有一个五彩的花卉镶嵌图案。
words.en: A mosaic is a picture or pattern produced by arranging together small colored pieces of hard material, such as stone, tile, or glass.

words.tr: phrase. 生育仪式；祈求丰收或生育能力的宗教仪式
words.ex: The tribe performed a fertility rite to ask for good harvests.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落举行了一次生育仪式，以祈求丰收。
words.en: A ceremonial practice performed to promote or ensure the fertility of people, animals, or land, often involving symbolic actions, prayers, or offerings.

words.ex: The revival of traditional music brought joy to many people.
words.ex_cn: 传统音乐的复兴给许多人带来了快乐。
words.en: The process of something becoming popular or active again after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.ex: He practices mindfulness to focus on his breathing.
words.ex_cn: 他练习注意自己的呼吸。
words.en: Mindfulness is the practice of purposely focusing your attention on the present moment and accepting it without judgment.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.ex: The report gave a sketchy description of the event.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告对事件的描述不完备。
words.en: If something is sketchy, it is incomplete or not detailed, and possibly unreliable.

words.ex: He runs a small-scale bakery in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他在镇上经营一家小型面包店。
words.en: involving or relating to a small number of people or things, or to a small area

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: He practiced stoicism by staying calm during hardship.
words.ex_cn: 他在逆境中保持冷静，践行斯多亚学派的哲学。
words.en: Stoicism is the endurance of pain or hardship without the display of feelings and without complaint.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.tr: adj. 引起兴趣的； v. 吸引；“appeal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book has an appealing story.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个引人入胜的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as appealing, you mean that you like them or they make you want to have or do something.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.ex: Honesty is a great virtue.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
words.en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

words.tr: phrase. 具有破坏性的情绪；指那些对个人心理或人际关系造成伤害的情感，如愤怒、嫉妒、仇恨等
words.ex: Anger and jealousy are destructive emotions.
words.ex_cn: 愤怒和嫉妒是有破坏性的情绪。
words.en: Emotions that cause harm or damage, either to oneself or to others, often leading to negative outcomes.

words.tr: phrase. 有意识的控制；指个体在清醒状态下对自身行为、思维或生理过程进行主动调节和管理的能力
words.ex: She exercised conscious control over her emotions during the heated argument.
words.ex_cn: 在激烈的争论中，她通过自我意识和自我控制来控制自己的情绪。
words.en: The deliberate regulation or command over one's thoughts, actions, or emotions.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.ex: The painting gave me inspiration.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画给了我灵感。
words.en: Inspiration is a feeling of enthusiasm you get from someone or something, which gives you new and creative ideas.

words.ex: Her teacher had a profound influence on her life.
words.ex_cn: 她的老师对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: A profound influence is a very great or intense effect that something has on a person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 认知行为疗法（一种通过改变思维和行为模式来治疗心理问题的心理治疗方法）
words.ex: Cognitive behaviour therapy is often used to treat anxiety and depression.
words.ex_cn: 认知行为疗法常用于治疗焦虑和抑郁。
words.en: A type of psychotherapy that helps patients understand the thoughts and feelings that influence behaviors.

words.tr: phrase. 非理性信念；不合理信念
words.ex: He held onto irrational beliefs despite clear evidence to the contrary.
words.ex_cn: 尽管有明确的相反证据，他仍然坚持不合理的信念。
words.en: Beliefs that are not based on reason or clear thinking, often resistant to change even when presented with contradictory evidence.

words.ex: Her resilience helped her recover after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 她的复原力帮助她在事故后恢复。
words.en: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.

words.ex: He had a setback when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，遇到了挫折。
words.en: A setback is an event that delays your progress or reverses some of the progress that you have made.

words.tr: phrase. 有原则的人；品格正直的人
words.ex: She is known for her principled character, always standing up for what she believes is right.
words.ex_cn: 她以有原则的性格著称，总是坚持她认为正确的事情。
words.en: A principled character refers to a person who consistently adheres to moral and ethical standards.

words.tr: phrase. 情景记忆；指对个人亲身经历过的特定事件或情景的记忆，通常包含时间、地点和相关情感等细节
words.ex: He remembers his first day of school as episodic memory.
words.ex_cn: 他把第一天上学的记忆作为情景记忆。
words.en: Episodic memory is the memory of autobiographical events (times, places, associated emotions, and other contextual who, what, when, where, why knowledge) that can be explicitly stated or conjured. It is the collection of past personal experiences that occurred at a particular time and place.

words.ex: He remembers his first bike ride through semantic memory.
words.ex_cn: 他通过语义记忆记得他第一次骑自行车的经历。
words.en: Semantic memory is a type of long-term memory that involves the recollection of general world knowledge, facts, and concepts.

words.ex: He will encode the message with a secret code.
words.ex_cn: 他将用密钥对这条信息进行编码。
words.en: To convert information into a particular form, especially for the purposes of secrecy or transmission.

words.ex: The company's consolidation improved its market position.
words.ex_cn: 公司的巩固增强了其市场地位。
words.en: The act of combining two or more things into a single more effective or coherent whole.

words.ex: The retrieval of lost files took a long time.
words.ex_cn: 找回丢失文件花费了很长时间。
words.en: The act of getting something back from somewhere.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: He smiled at the recollection of his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他回忆起童年时微笑了。
words.en: The act of remembering something or the ability to remember.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.tr: v. 促进；使便利；使容易；
words.ex: The teacher facilitates learning by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来促进学习。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fade in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色在阳光下逐渐消失。
words.en: To gradually grow faint and disappear.

words.ex: The olfactory nerve helps us smell food.
words.ex_cn: 嗅神经帮助我们闻到食物的味道。
words.en: Relating to the sense of smell.

words.ex: The auditory system helps us hear sounds.
words.ex_cn: 听觉系统帮助我们听到声音。
words.en: Relating to the sense of hearing.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.tr: adj. 神经（病）学的；神经系统的；
words.ex: The doctor checked for neurological damage after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，医生检查是否有神经学方面的损伤。
words.en: Relating to the anatomy, functions, and organic disorders of nerves and the nervous system.

words.ex: The accident caused an impairment in his vision.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故导致了他的视力受损。
words.en: An impairment is a condition in which a part of a person's mind or body is damaged or does not work well.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.ex: He has symptoms of a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有感冒的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: He uses computer-assisted tools to learn math.
words.ex_cn: 他使用计算机辅助工具来学习数学。
words.en: Using computers to help perform a task or process.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.ex: His absence of interest made the teacher sad.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习的缺乏兴趣让老师感到难过。
words.en: The state of being away from a place or person.

words.ex: She enjoys hand knitting sweaters for her family.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢为家人手工编织毛衣。
words.en: The activity or skill of knitting by hand, without the use of a machine.

words.ex: She bought a new garment for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件新衣服。
words.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes.

words.tr: phrase. 朴实无华的图像；家常的图像无中文释义
words.ex: The photo shows a homely image of a family eating dinner.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了一个家庭吃晚餐的温馨画面。
words.en: A simple, familiar, or cozy picture or concept.

words.tr: phrase. 开始衰落；走下坡路
words.ex: The old factory goes into decline after the workers leave.
words.ex_cn: 工人离开后，这家老工厂开始衰落。
words.en: To begin to decrease in quality, quantity, or importance; to start to deteriorate or weaken.

words.tr: phrase. 传下来的；传承的（指传统、故事、财产等由上一代传给下一代）
words.ex: The recipe was passed down from my grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱是从我祖母那里传下来的。
words.en: Transmitted or handed down through generations or over time.

words.tr: phrase. 正式教学；正规指导
words.ex: He learned to play piano through formal instruction.
words.ex_cn: 他通过正规教学学习弹钢琴。
words.en: Formal instruction refers to the systematic teaching or guidance provided in an official or structured setting, often leading to the acquisition of knowledge or skills.

words.tr: phrase. 销售额；销售数据；销量统计
words.ex: The sales figures for the first quarter were disappointing.
words.ex_cn: 第一季度的销售数字令人失望。
words.en: Sales figures refer to the numerical data that represent the amount of sales achieved by a business over a certain period of time.

words.ex: She sells handmade handicraft at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上出售手工制品。
words.en: Handicraft refers to activities where useful and decorative objects are made completely by hand or by using only simple tools.

words.tr: phrase. 经济困难；经济困境
words.ex: Many families face economic hardship during the recession.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭在经济衰退期间面临经济困难。
words.en: Economic hardship refers to a condition where individuals or communities face financial difficulties, often leading to a reduced standard of living.

words.tr: phrase. 财务支出；资金投入；金钱上的花费
words.ex: The small business had a large financial outlay for new equipment.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业为新设备支付了大量资金。
words.en: An amount of money spent on something, especially as an initial investment or cost.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.tr: 快节奏的生活：指生活节奏快，充满紧张和压力的生活方式。
words.ex: He lives a fast-paced life in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城市里过着快节奏的生活。
words.en: A lifestyle characterized by a high speed of activity and a rapid succession of events.

words.tr: phrase. 考古遗迹；考古遗存
words.ex: Workers found archaeological remains near the old temple.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在古庙附近发现了考古遗迹。
words.en: Archaeological remains are physical evidence of past human activity, such as artifacts, buildings, and bones, which have been preserved over time and are studied by archaeologists to understand historical cultures and civilizations.

words.ex: He refused to disclose the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝透露这个秘密。
words.en: To disclose information means to make it known to the public.

words.ex: The old woman uses a spinning wheel to make yarn.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人用纺车纺纱。
words.en: A spinning wheel is a device for spinning thread or yarn from natural or synthetic fibers.

words.ex: His dominance in the game surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的支配表现让所有人感到惊讶。
words.en: Dominance is the state of being more powerful, important, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.tr: phrase. 视觉识别；视觉形象（指品牌或组织通过视觉元素如标志、色彩、字体等建立的统一形象）
words.ex: The company created a new visual identity for its brand.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司为其品牌创建了一个新的视觉识别系统。
words.en: The visual aspects of a brand or organization that together create an image or impression in the mind of the public.

words.ex: They unearthed an old coin in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他们在花园里挖出了一枚旧硬币。
words.en: To unearth something means to find it by digging in the ground or to discover something that was hidden or unknown.

words.tr: n. 预测；预测 v. 预言，预报( forecast的现在分词 )； v. 预言；预报；
words.ex: Weather forecasting helps us plan our day.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测帮助我们规划一天。
words.en: Forecasting involves making predictions about future events based on past and present data.

words.tr: phrase. 把……归因于；认为……是由于
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: He bought the toy on a whim.
words.ex_cn: 他一时兴起买了这个玩具。
words.en: A whim is a sudden desire or change of mind, especially one that is unusual or unexplained.

words.ex: The earthquake was a catastrophe.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场灾难。
words.en: An event causing great and often sudden damage or suffering; a disaster.

words.ex: He follows ancient rites every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年都会遵循古老的仪式。
words.en: A rite is a traditional ceremony or ritual, especially one that is associated with a particular religion or culture.

words.ex: He made careful observations about the birds.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细观察了这些鸟。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully, in order to gain information.

words.ex: The strange phenomena in the forest puzzled scientists.
words.ex_cn: 森林中奇怪的现象让科学家们感到困惑。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something interesting or unusual.

words.ex: The children noticed patterns in the tiles on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们注意到了地板瓷砖上的模式。
words.en: Designs or motifs that are repeated in a predictable sequence.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.tr: adj. 天空的；天体的；天国的；
words.ex: The celestial lights shone brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中的光芒在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Relating to the sky or the heavens; belonging or relating to heaven as the abode of the gods.

words.tr: n. （图画中圣人头上的）光环，灵光( halo的名词复数 )
words.ex: The painting shows saints with golden haloes above their heads.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了圣人头上有着金色的光环。
words.en: A circle of light shown around or above the head of a saint or holy person to represent their holiness.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.tr: v. 改正； adj. 改正，矫正( rectify的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He rectified the mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了作业中的错误。
words.en: If someone rectifies something that is wrong, they change it so that it becomes correct or satisfactory.

words.ex: My grandmother often tells proverbs to teach me life lessons.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶经常用谚语来教我人生道理。
words.en: A proverb is a short, commonly known saying that expresses a truth based on common sense or experience.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The lab has many scientific instruments.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有许多科学仪器。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work.

words.tr: phrase. 风向标；用于指示风向的装置
words.ex: The weather vane points north when the wind blows.
words.ex_cn: 当风吹时，风向标指向北方。
words.en: A weather vane is an instrument for showing the direction of the wind, typically mounted on top of a building.

words.tr: phrase. 雨量计; 雨量测量器
words.ex: The rain gauge shows how much rain fell yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 雨量计显示了昨天下了多少雨。
words.en: A device for measuring the amount of rain that falls.

words.ex: The hygrometer shows the humidity in the room.
words.ex_cn: 湿度计显示房间里的湿度。
words.en: A hygrometer is an instrument used for measuring the moisture content in the atmosphere.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.ex: Atmospheric pressure affects weather patterns.
words.ex_cn: 大气压影响天气模式。
words.en: Atmospheric pressure is the pressure exerted by the weight of air in the atmosphere of Earth (or that of another planet).

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.tr: v. 证实；“verify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The scientist verified the results with a second test.
words.ex_cn: 科学家用第二次实验证实了结果。
words.en: Confirmed as true or accurate by evidence or testimony.

words.tr: phrase. 信风；贸易风（指赤道附近稳定吹拂的东风）
words.ex: The trade winds blow steadily from the east.
words.ex_cn: 信风从东方稳定地吹来。
words.en: The trade winds are a pattern of wind that is found in bands around the Earth's equatorial region. They are caused by the Earth's rotation and the heat from the sun, and they have been used by sailors to navigate the oceans for centuries.

words.tr: v. 整理（文件或书等）；整理；校对( collate的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He collated the reports before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前整理了这些报告。
words.en: To collect, compare carefully in order to verify, and often to integrate or arrange in order.

words.ex: He works in meteorology and predicts the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他从事气象学工作，预测天气。
words.en: Meteorology is the scientific study of the atmosphere and of atmospheric conditions, especially as they relate to weather and weather forecasting.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.tr: n. 元素；要素（尤指）风雨；“element”的复数；
words.ex: The elements battered the small cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风雨在暴风雨中猛烈袭击了小木屋。
words.en: The elements of something are the basic parts or aspects of it.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.ex: Power plants make electricity for cities.
words.ex_cn: 发电厂为城市提供电力。
words.en: A power plant is an industrial facility for the generation of electric power.

words.tr: v. 释放；发布；“release”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The zoo released the tiger back into the wild.
words.ex_cn: 动物园把老虎放回了野外。
words.en: If someone or something is released, they are allowed to go or be taken out of a place where they have been kept or trapped.

words.tr: v. <正>吃，吞下；<正>吃，吞下( ingest的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He ingested the medicine with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水吞下了药。
words.en: Taken into the body through the mouth and swallowed, especially referring to food, drink, or medicine.

words.tr: v. 排泄； adj. 分泌（excrete 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The body excreted waste through the kidneys.
words.ex_cn: 身体通过肾脏排泄废物。
words.en: To excrete means to separate and eliminate or discharge (waste) from the body or an organism.

words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.tr: v. 污染；弄脏；“contaminate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The river was contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 河流被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: If something is contaminated, it has been made dirty or harmful, usually by the addition of something, especially chemicals or radiation.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.ex: The equation has two variables, x and y.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程有两个变量，x 和 y。
words.en: In mathematics and programming, a variable is a symbol used to represent an unknown or changeable value.

words.ex: Birds are migratory in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天是迁徙的。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by migration; tending to migrate.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.ex: The child shows developmental delays in speech and movement.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在语言和运动方面有发育迟缓。
words.en: Delays in a child's physical, cognitive, social, or emotional development compared to typical milestones.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: The company must follow the safety regulations.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须遵守安全条例。
words.en: Regulations are rules or laws designed to control the way that something happens or is done.

words.tr: n. 散发；排放；放射；“emission”的复数
words.ex: Cars produce harmful emissions.
words.ex_cn: 汽车产生有害的排放物。
words.en: Emissions are substances that are sent out into the air, especially by vehicles or industrial processes.

words.ex: Climate change is making the weather hotter.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化让天气变得更热。
words.en: A significant and lasting change in the Earth's climate, especially a change due to an increase in the average atmospheric temperature.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.tr: v. 吸收；“absorb”的现在分词； adj. 吸引人的；
words.ex: The sponge is absorbing water.
words.ex_cn: 海绵正在吸收水。
words.en: If something is absorbing, it is very interesting and holds your attention completely.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.ex: Water causes erosion of the soil.
words.ex_cn: 水会导致土壤腐蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.ex: The hikers struggled across the rough terrain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿越了崎岖的地形。
words.en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏的；没有的（通常与 'of' 连用，表示完全缺少某种特质或事物）
words.ex: The room was devoid of furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有家具。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is devoid of a quality or thing, you are emphasizing that they have none of it.

words.ex: The soil contains a lot of organic matter.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中含有大量的有机物。
words.en: Organic matter refers to the large pool of carbon-based compounds found within natural and engineered, terrestrial and aquatic environments. It is matter composed of organic compounds that have come from the remains of organisms such as plants and animals and their waste products in the environment.

words.ex: Microbes live in the soil and help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 微生物生活在土壤中，帮助植物生长。
words.en: Microbes are very small living things, especially ones that cause disease, which can only be seen with a microscope.

words.tr: v. 使混乱，扰乱；使混乱，扰乱( disrupt的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The storm disrupted the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴扰乱了火车时刻表。
words.en: If someone or something disrupts an event, system, or process, they cause difficulties that prevent it from continuing or operating in a normal way.

words.ex: Farmers protect the topsoil to grow healthy crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民保护表土以种植健康的作物。
words.en: Topsoil is the upper layer of soil, usually the top 2 inches (5.1 cm) to 8 inches (20 cm). It has the highest concentration of organic matter and microorganisms and is where most of the Earth's biological soil activity occurs.

words.tr: n. 放牧；草场； v. 吃草；“graze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The farmers practice grazing on the open land.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在开阔的土地上进行放牧。
words.en: The act of animals feeding on grass or the land where such feeding occurs.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 再生农业；一种通过恢复土壤健康、增加生物多样性、改善水循环和增强生态系统服务来重建和增强自然资源的耕作方式
words.ex: Farmers use regenerative agriculture to heal the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用再生农业来修复土壤。
words.en: Farming methods that restore and enhance soil health and biodiversity.

words.ex: The doctor checked her fertility to help her get pregnant.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了她的生育力，以帮助她怀孕。
words.en: Fertility refers to the ability to produce offspring or to the quality of being fertile, especially in terms of soil or land.

words.ex: The soil is moist after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后土壤是潮湿的。
words.en: Slightly wet; damp or humid.

words.ex: He uses compost to make his garden soil richer.
words.ex_cn: 他用堆肥来使花园的土壤更肥沃。
words.en: Compost is a mixture of decaying organic matter, such as leaves and food scraps, used to improve soil structure and provide nutrients for plants.

words.ex: Farmers spread manure on the fields to help crops grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民把肥料撒在田里以帮助庄稼生长。
words.en: Manure is organic matter used as fertilizer in agriculture.

words.tr: v. 耕作；培养；“cultivate”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farmers are cultivating rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民正在田里耕作水稻。
words.en: Developing or improving something, especially a skill, quality, or relationship, through careful effort and attention.

words.tr: phrase. 温室气体（如二氧化碳、甲烷等，能导致全球变暖的气体）
words.ex: Cars and factories release greenhouse gases.
words.ex_cn: 汽车和工厂排放温室气体。
words.en: Gases that trap heat in the atmosphere, contributing to the greenhouse effect and global warming. Examples include carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrous oxide.

words.ex: Smartphones have many useful applications.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机有许多有用的程序。
words.en: An application is a formal request to be considered for a position or to be allowed to do or have something, submitted to an authority, institution, or organization. It can also refer to the practical use or relevance of something, or a program or piece of software designed to fulfill a particular purpose.

words.ex: He poured maple syrup on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把枫糖浆倒在煎饼上。
words.en: Maple syrup is a sweet syrup made from the sap of maple trees, primarily the sugar maple, red maple, or black maple, although it can be made from other maple species as well.

words.tr:
n. 树液；
v. 使逐渐耗竭；使削弱；
words.ex: The tree releases sap in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在春天流出树液。
words.en: Sap is the watery fluid that circulates in the vascular system of a plant, carrying nutrients and sugars. It can also refer to the vitality or energy of a person or thing.

words.ex: This bread has many preservatives to last longer.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包含有许多防腐剂以延长保质期。
words.en: Substances used to prevent the growth of microorganisms and to retard spoilage, especially in food.

words.ex: He avoids refined sugar in his diet.
words.ex_cn: 他避免在饮食中摄入精制糖。
words.en: Refined sugar is sugar that has been processed to remove impurities and molasses, resulting in a white, crystalline product.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: Too much sun exposure can hurt your skin.
words.ex_cn: 过多的日晒会伤害你的皮肤。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to the sun's rays, especially for an extended period.

words.tr: phrase. 原住民社区；土著社区
words.ex: Indigenous communities live near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 土著社区住在森林附近。
words.en: Groups of people who have historically inhabited a particular region or land, often maintaining distinct cultural, social, and linguistic traditions that are deeply rooted in their ancestral environment.

words.tr: phrase. 被钻出的孔；钻孔（指通过钻削加工形成的孔）
words.ex: The wooden board has bored holes for the screws.
words.ex_cn: 木板上有用于螺丝的钻出的孔。
words.en: A hole made by drilling or boring, typically in metal or wood, often for the purpose of inserting a screw, bolt, or other fastener.

words.tr: phrase. 储存设施；仓储设备
words.ex: The company uses storage facilities for old boxes.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用仓储设施存放旧箱子。
words.en: Storage facilities refer to the buildings or spaces used for storing goods or materials.

words.ex: The sun is scorching hot at noon.
words.ex_cn: 中午的太阳非常炎热。
words.en: extremely hot

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.tr: phrase. 血管系统；循环系统（包括动脉、静脉和毛细血管，负责输送血液）
words.ex: The vascular system carries blood through the body.
words.ex_cn: 血管系统将血液输送到全身。
words.en: The network of vessels that carries blood throughout the body.

words.tr: v. （从容器等）汲取（液体）；开发； adj. 发接触音的 v. 开发( tap的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He tapped the barrel to get some water.
words.ex_cn: 他从桶里舀了一些水。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows.

words.ex: He is drilling a hole in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他正在墙上钻孔。

words.tr: v. 使某物蒸发掉；消失；不复存在；
words.ex: The sun evaporates the water from the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑里的水蒸发掉。
words.en: Becomes vapor or gas, especially through heating or evaporation; disappears gradually.

words.ex: The factory uses evaporators to remove water.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用蒸发器来去除水分。
words.en: Evaporators are devices used to turn a liquid into a gas, often used in industrial processes to concentrate solutions by removing water or other solvents.

words.tr: phrase. 被过滤掉；被筛选出去
words.ex: The system filtered out bad data.
words.ex_cn: 系统过滤掉了错误的数据。
words.en: To remove solid particles or impurities from a liquid by passing it through a porous medium.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 粗糙的口感；带有沙粒感的味道
words.ex: The coffee has a gritty taste.
words.ex_cn: 这杯咖啡有粗糙的口感。
words.en: A texture or sensation in the mouth, especially in food or drink, that feels coarse, sandy, or containing small hard particles.

words.tr: adj. 包装过的； v. “package”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He bought packaged snacks for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行买了包装好的零食。
words.en: If goods are packaged, they are put into containers or wrapped in material so that they are ready to be sold or sent.

words.tr: adj. 充满令人激动情节的
words.ex: The movie is action-packed and exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影充满动作，令人兴奋。
words.en: Filled with exciting events or actions; full of activity.

words.tr: phrase. 听力受损的；听力障碍的
words.ex: He is hearing impaired and uses sign language.
words.ex_cn: 他听力受损，使用手语。
words.en: Having a reduced or limited ability to hear.

words.ex: He is an illustrator who draws pictures for children's books.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位为儿童书籍画画的插画师。
words.en: An illustrator is an artist who draws pictures, especially for books.

words.tr: adj. 有抱负的；有志向的； v. “aspire”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is an aspiring writer who dreams of publishing a novel.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有抱负的作家，梦想出版一部小说。
words.en: If you use aspiring to describe someone who is starting a particular career, you mean that they are trying to become successful in it.

words.ex: The children do role play in class.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在课堂上进行角色扮演。
words.en: Role play is a method in which individuals act out roles in scenarios to explore and understand different perspectives or to practice skills.

words.tr: phrase. 心理健康；精神状态
words.ex: He cares about his mental health every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很关心自己的心理健康。
words.en: Mental health refers to the state of one's psychological and emotional well-being.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr: adj. 激发同情心的，暖人心房的
words.ex: The letter was heart-warming.
words.ex_cn: 这封信很暖心。
words.en: Something that is heart-warming causes you to feel happy, usually because it involves kindness or love.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A gold medal is a medal made of gold, or a medal of the color gold, that is awarded as the highest prize in a competition or event.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: n. 根；根源；根本；“root”的复数；
words.ex: The roots of the equation are 2 and 3.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程的根是2和3。
words.en: The underground parts of a plant that anchor it and absorb water and nutrients.

words.tr: 钢鼓：一种由钢制成的打击乐器，常用于加勒比地区的音乐表演。
words.ex: The band played a lively tune on the steel drums.
words.ex_cn: 乐队用钢鼓演奏了一首欢快的曲子。
words.en: Steel drums are a type of percussion instrument made from oil barrels, originating from Trinidad and Tobago. They are known for their distinctive sound and are often used in Caribbean music.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.ex: He learned carpentry from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里学到了木工工作。
words.en: Carpentry is the activity of making and repairing wooden things.

words.ex: He specializes in the technical side of film production.
words.ex_cn: 他专注于电影制作的技术方面。
words.en: The aspect of a subject that involves practical skills and specialized knowledge.

words.tr: n. 化妆品；性格；构成；补考
words.ex: She put on make-up before the party.
words.ex_cn: 她在派对前化了妆。
words.en: The way someone's face is enhanced with cosmetics; also, the composition or arrangement of something.

words.tr: noun招聘顾问，指专门为寻找熟练或专业工作的人提供专业建议，或为寻找熟练或专业工人的公司提供专业建议的人
words.ex: He works as a recruitment consultant for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是一家大公司的招聘顾问。
words.en: A recruitment consultant is a professional who helps companies find and hire new employees.

words.ex: He works in horticulture at a local garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地的一个花园从事园艺工作。
words.en: Horticulture is the study and practice of growing and cultivating plants, especially flowers, fruits, and vegetables.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.ex: She tries to juggle her job and caring for her kids.
words.ex_cn: 她努力兼顾工作和照顾孩子。
words.en: If you juggle, you keep several objects in motion in the air at the same time by repeatedly throwing and catching them. Juggle can also mean to deal with several things at the same time, often in a skillful way.

words.tr: phrase. 乡村环境；农村背景；田园场景
words.ex: The school is in a rural setting with few nearby houses.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校位于一个乡村环境中，附近几乎没有房子。
words.en: A rural setting refers to the countryside or areas that are not urban, characterized by natural landscapes, agriculture, and a slower pace of life compared to cities.

words.tr: phrase. 偏远地区；边远地区；人烟稀少的区域
words.ex: The children live in remote areas with no schools.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子住在没有学校的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas refer to places that are far away from cities or towns, often characterized by limited access to services and infrastructure.

words.tr: phrase. 商务经理；负责公司商业活动和策略的管理人员
words.ex: The commercial manager is responsible for negotiating contracts with suppliers.
words.ex_cn: 商务经理负责与供应商谈判合同。
words.en: A commercial manager is a professional responsible for overseeing the commercial activities of a company, including sales, marketing, and business development strategies.

words.tr: phrase. 节奏快的工作环境；快节奏的环境
words.ex: She thrives in a fast-paced environment where every day brings new challenges.
words.ex_cn: 她在快节奏的环境中茁壮成长，每天都有新的挑战。
words.en: A fast-paced environment is one where things happen quickly and there is a lot of activity and change.

words.tr: phrase. 利润率；利润幅度；盈利空间
words.ex: The company aims to increase its profit margins by reducing costs.
words.ex_cn: 公司通过降低成本来提高利润率。
words.en: The difference between the cost of producing or buying something and the price at which it is sold, considered as a measure of the financial success of a business.

words.ex: The agronomist helped farmers grow better crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农艺学家帮助农民种植更好的作物。
words.en: An agronomist is a scientist who specializes in soil management and crop production.

words.tr: n. 害虫；有害的人或物( pest的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The farmers sprayed poison to kill pests.
words.ex_cn: 农民喷洒农药来杀死害虫。
words.en: Pests are insects or small animals which damage crops or food supplies.

words.tr: phrase. 产假期间的临时替代人员
words.ex: She was hired as a maternity cover for six months.
words.ex_cn: 她被聘为六个月的产假替代人员。
words.en: A temporary position or person employed to replace someone who is on maternity leave.

words.tr: phrase. 有竞争力的薪酬；指薪资水平在市场上具有吸引力，能够与同类职位相比较并具备优势
words.ex: The company offers a competitive salary to attract top talent.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供有竞争力的薪酬以吸引顶尖人才。
words.en: A competitive salary is a wage that is high enough to attract and retain employees, especially in comparison to what other employers are offering for similar positions.

words.ex: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 销售部门有一个空缺职位。
words.en: A vacancy is a position or job that is available for someone to fill.

words.tr: phrase. 保护工作； conservation 指对自然资源、环境或文物的保护，work 指相关的工作或活动
words.ex: He does conservation work in the national park.
words.ex_cn: 他在国家公园做保护工作。
words.en: Activities aimed at protecting and maintaining natural environments and species.

words.ex: His job has many perks, like free lunch and flexible hours.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作有很多福利，比如免费午餐和弹性工作时间。
words.en: Perks are extra benefits or advantages that you get in addition to your salary or wages, often as part of your job.

words.tr: phrase. 实习岗位；工作实习安排
words.ex: He did a work placement at a local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家本地医院完成了实习。
words.en: A work placement is a temporary position with an employer, usually arranged by an educational institution, to give students practical experience in a particular field.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.tr: phrase. 安全隐患；对安全的担忧；安全顾虑
words.ex: The broken ladder is a safety concern.
words.ex_cn: 这个破损的梯子是一个安全问题。
words.en: A safety concern is a worry or fear about the possibility of something bad happening, especially in relation to the safety of people.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: The spectator watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: A spectator is someone who watches an event, show, game, or activity.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

words.tr: n. 行程安排； v. “schedule”的现在分词；
words.ex: The teacher made a scheduling for the week's lessons.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了本周课程的行程安排。
words.en: The process of arranging, controlling, and optimizing work and workloads in a production process or manufacturing process.

words.tr: phrase. 修改时间表；调整日程安排
words.ex: We need to alter the timetable to accommodate the new schedule.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要更改时间表以适应新的日程安排。
words.en: To change the schedule or plan, especially to make it different from what was originally intended.

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.tr: 短语动词. 以平局结束；以不分胜负告终
words.ex: The football match ended in a draw.
words.ex_cn: 这场足球比赛以平局结束。
words.en: To finish a game or contest with neither side winning.

words.ex: The teacher gave him on-the-spot feedback.
words.ex_cn: 老师当场给了他反馈。
words.en: Happening or done immediately, without any delay.

words.tr: phrase. 时间管理；对时间的有效规划与控制
words.ex: He practices time management to finish his homework early.
words.ex_cn: 他练习时间管理，以便早点完成作业。
words.en: The process of planning and exercising conscious control over the amount of time spent on specific activities, especially to increase effectiveness, efficiency, or productivity.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.tr: n. 多任务处理；同时处理多项任务
words.ex: He is good at multi-tasking while working.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作时擅长同时处理多项任务。
words.en: The act of performing multiple tasks simultaneously or switching between them efficiently.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.tr: phrase. 全局；整体情况；宏观视角
words.ex: We need to understand the big picture before making any decisions.
words.ex_cn: 在做出任何决定之前，我们需要了解全局。
words.en: The big picture refers to the overall perspective or the most important facts about a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 细微之处；精妙细节
words.ex: He explained the fine points of the contract.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了合同的细节。
words.en: The subtle or precise details of something, often requiring careful attention or expertise to understand or appreciate.

words.tr: n. 领导才能；领导地位；
words.ex: His leadership helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导才能帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Leadership is the ability to lead, guide, or direct a group, organization, or country.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.tr: phrase. 最终责任；终极责任
words.ex: The CEO bears ultimate responsibility for the company's performance.
words.ex_cn: 首席执行官对公司的业绩承担最终责任。
words.en: The final obligation or duty that cannot be delegated or passed on to someone else.

words.tr: n. 建立人际关系网；网络化；
words.ex: He went to the party for networking.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加聚会是为了建立人际关系网。
words.en: The process of interacting with others to exchange information and develop professional or social contacts.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.tr: adj.家族流传的; 家庭经营的
words.ex: This small restaurant is family-run and has been open for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 这家小餐馆是家族传承的，已经开了50年。
words.en: Managed or operated by members of a family.

words.tr: phrase. 个人特色；个性化处理；人情味；亲切感
words.ex: She added a personal touch to the card.
words.ex_cn: 她在卡片上加了一点个人风格。
words.en: An individual or distinctive quality that adds warmth or character.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.ex: He paid an administrative fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了一笔行政费用以加入俱乐部。
words.en: A charge made for the administrative costs of a service or process.

words.tr: phrase. 向外眺望；注视（窗外、远处等）
words.ex: He likes to look out at the sea from his window.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢从窗户往外看大海。
words.en: To direct one's gaze outward at something, typically from a window or high place.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.tr: v. 起作用；运行；行使职责；“function”的现在分词；
words.ex: The machine is functioning well.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转良好。
words.en: The operation or working of something.

words.ex: We walked along the promenade by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的步行区散步。
words.en: A promenade is a leisurely walk, especially one taken in a public place for pleasure or display.

words.tr: phrase. 由马匹拉动的有轨电车；马车轨道车
words.ex: The old horse-drawn tram moved slowly through the street.
words.ex_cn: 古老的马车电车缓缓驶过街道。
words.en: A horse-drawn tram is a type of public transport that was common in the 19th and early 20th centuries, consisting of a carriage or car running on rails and pulled by horses.

words.tr: phrase. 文化遗产地；历史遗迹
words.ex: The government protects heritage sites from damage.
words.ex_cn: 政府保护遗产地免受破坏。
words.en: Places of significant cultural, historical, or natural importance that are preserved for future generations.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠着点
words.ex: Take it easy, the test is not hard.
words.ex_cn: 别紧张，考试不难。
words.en: To relax and not do anything too energetic or stressful.

words.ex: The lighthouse is on the headland.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔位于海角上。
words.en: A headland is a narrow piece of land that projects from a coastline into the sea.

words.ex: He reads mediaeval stories about knights.
words.ex_cn: 他读关于骑士的中世纪故事。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages.

words.ex: The tour guide showed us the old castle.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古老的城堡。
words.en: A tour guide is a person who leads groups of people around a town, museum, or other tourist attraction, providing information about the place.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: The exterior of the house is painted white.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观是白色的。
words.en: The outer surface or structure of something.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.
